sql_infos.sql: SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_brand_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 507505.23 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 18.81 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.28 AND 1995.9 AND p.p_size > 35.47 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 228156.67 AND COUNT(*) > 802.13 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year) AS running_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 7.68 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.53 AND 4.9 AND d.d_year >= 1995.92 AND d.d_year <= 1994.44 AND p.p_size >= 35.15 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 305115.28 AND COUNT(*) > 585.22 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 307043 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 21 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 109946 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19945324 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19981111) AS avg_cust_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 952110 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.8 AND 8.47 AND d.d_year = 1994.43 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM part p WHERE p.p_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 300269.06 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 AND lo.lo_quantity > 58 AND dd.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 8 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3041425 AND COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 39 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 1 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 5 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8027838 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 6 AND (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) > 1382115 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 229260 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 6 AND 99 AND lo.lo_discount >= 5 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND dd.d_year <= 1999 AND (p.p_size > 38 OR p.p_container IN (SELECT p2.p_container FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_color = 'BLACK' AND p2.p_mfgr LIKE 'Manufacturer#1')) AND s.s_region IN (SELECT s2.s_region FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo2.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 50059 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 100 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 3951;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19961273 AND 19978141) AS max_order_total_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount >= 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 66 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 31 AND 31 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1516372 AND COUNT(*) > 580 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 43 AND 49 AND lo.lo_commitdate >= 19928756 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1993 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19962387 AND 19961818) AND COUNT(*) > 447 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 2550;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 51 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 9 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'FRANCE', 'JAPAN') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9001076 AND COUNT(*) >= 361 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 38 AND p.p_size >= 28 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND dd.d_year <= 1994 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6890566 AND COUNT(*) >= 89 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 34 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 27 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4502772 AND COUNT(*) >= 597 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS median_order_total, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS third_quartile_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1992 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND p.p_size >= 6 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 62562444 AND COUNT(*) > 68 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l.lo_orderdate < l2.lo_orderdate JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 13 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 9 AND l2.lo_quantity > 3 AND d2.d_year = d.d_year + 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9897199 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 13 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 507317.04 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 19.96 AND p.p_size <= 31.17 AND l.lo_discount >= 8.56 AND l.lo_discount <= 3.39 AND d.d_year >= 1994.71 AND d.d_year <= 1995.65 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 744293.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 92.39 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, s.s_nation ASC LIMIT 8402.75;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND p.p_size >= 15 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 67 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2486284 AND COUNT(*) >= 204 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 235;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(inner_l.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19979691 ) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 442782 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19971215) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 161042 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 11 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size >= 50 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 29566882 AND COUNT(*) >= 126 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_nation_year_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1995 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND lo.lo_quantity > 2 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 4 AND p.p_size >= 3 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 352625 AND COUNT(*) >= 56 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 13 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 618876 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS prev_revenue_in_group FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 649402.85 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 30.79 AND p.p_size <= 40.6 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.02 AND 1.59 AND d1.d_year = 1994.34 AND d2.d_year >= 1997.36 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1228605.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 615.61 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, supplier_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 46.79;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ( SELECT SUM(l2.lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder l2 JOIN supplier s2 ON l2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey WHERE s2.s_nation = s.s_nation AND l2.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19957851 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= 19932828 ) AS total_supplycost_by_nation_part FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19936881 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19972211 AND l.lo_discount >= 5 AND l.lo_discount <= 5 AND p.p_size >= 7 AND p.p_size <= 20 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8992423 AND COUNT(*) > 338 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_nation ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19977078 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19967103 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND (d.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 OR d.d_holidayfl = 1) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 52 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 4 AND 14 AND (p.p_container = 'JUMBO BOX' OR p.p_container = 'JUMBO PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2697628 AND COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 42 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 41 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 79110 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 45 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND p.p_size > 48 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5679840 AND COUNT(*) >= 663 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9450 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19935141) AS max_extended_price_for_part FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, p.p_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 131396 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3787113 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 32 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3207997 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 208268 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6415906 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9273 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9215 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '-' || lo.lo_linenumber::text) AS distinct_lineitems, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 15 AND lo.lo_commitdate <= lo.lo_orderdate + 212 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 32063686 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 685 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '-' || lo.lo_linenumber::text) AS unique_line_items, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 736040.84 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 16.47 AND 53.46 AND d.d_year >= 1993.58 AND p.p_size > 13.25 AND lo.lo_discount < 9.84 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2975797.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 573.84 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 66 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size IN (37, 31, 49) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 190624 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 24 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice < 38985 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'AIR', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size = 36 AND p.p_container = 'SM CASE') AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_region = 'ASIA') AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 269392 AND COUNT(*) >= 27 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year) AS running_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 31 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 232593 AND COUNT(*) >= 43 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 740 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 409234 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_last_30_days, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_last_30_days, COUNT(*) AS order_count_last_30_days FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_date >= '1992-01-01' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.79 AND 6.4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 824915.12 ORDER BY total_revenue_last_30_days DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 109269 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 299 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 71 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 45 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 123 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_discount) AS p75_discount, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 23 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 204803 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 850639 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue_per_order, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 41 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 992903 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19960224 AND 19952784) AS max_extended_price_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 33 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 46 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5525187 AND COUNT(*) > 899 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 142;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p75_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p90_supplycost FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 740501 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 50 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 40 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 318583 AND COUNT(*) > 28 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 13) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 25099 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'ASIA') AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND (p.p_size > 44 OR p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'MED BAG', 'LG BOX')) AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 436681 AND COUNT(*) >= 18 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_revenue > 56951 AND lo_quantity >= 4 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 257) AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1996 AND p.p_size >= 50 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND s.s_region = (SELECT s_region FROM supplier WHERE s_nation = c.c_nation LIMIT 1) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.11 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = d.d_year - 1)) AND COUNT(*) >= 679 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100)) AS net_sales, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_commitdate) AS earliest_commit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19922066 AND p.p_size > 34 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1995, 1992) AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5300261 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 22 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 591 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 494;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(lo.lo_tax) AS max_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 6982065.17 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 56.92 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992.82 AND 1997.45 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 10.88 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4938361.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 854.32 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 7021.8;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 955088.98 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 66.17 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.38 AND 17.74 AND d.d_year >= 1994.83 AND p.p_size > 23.86 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 224923.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 43.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 12577944.65 AND l.lo_quantity >= 7.73 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.96 AND 7.46 AND d.d_year >= 1994.95 AND d.d_year <= 1993.01 AND p.p_size > 42.28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region), (s.s_region), (p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 757916734.92 AND COUNT(*) >= 8672.98 ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS LAST, s.s_region NULLS LAST, d.d_year DESC NULLS LAST, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND lo.lo_discount <= 0 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9219716 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8038 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 898 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 OR l.lo_tax > 0) AND NOT (p.p_size < 1 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5435701 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT AVG(lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND lo_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey) AS avg_supplycost_for_line FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey, l.lo_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 645296 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT AVG(lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND lo_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey) AS avg_supplycost_for_line FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey, l.lo_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 893534 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 13 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2656108 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1995.76 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 296303.8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 829055 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 32 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6074870 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 22 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 14636299 AND COUNT(*) >= 6760 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 63018.57 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 36.37 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.41 AND 2.75 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1991.76 AND p.p_size > 17.59 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 493584.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 270.75 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS cust1_total_revenue, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS cust2_total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(lo2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_suppkey = lo2.lo_suppkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey AND c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE dd1.d_year >= 1993 AND dd2.d_year <= 1992 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 45 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 17 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 4 AND SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 576207 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, cust1_total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19979228 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 1 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19960929 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19957462 AND p.p_size > 17 AND lo.lo_quantity < 57 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 45879342 AND COUNT(*) >= 764 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 3913.96 AND d.d_year >= 1993.04 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 23.81 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 920283 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 224926 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 641551 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 672910 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1997 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 978338 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 13 AND d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 464131 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND p.p_brand1 = 'MFGR#1111' AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_supplycost) < 975 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19955781) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_color LIKE 'blue' AND d.d_year = 1993.89 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.34 AND 8.86 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 535989.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount >= 0 AND l.lo_discount <= 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 651129 AND COUNT(*) >= 69 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
