SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 958419.88 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 68.76 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996.58 AND 1992.23 AND p.p_size > 46.34 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'BUILDING', 'MACHINERY') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.62 AND 0.6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 129901.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 15.51 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 508.08;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_quantity > 29) AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1995 AND p.p_size > 22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 3 AND (lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' OR lo.lo_shipmode = 'TRUCK') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2209101 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 77 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year ASC, revenue_rank_in_segment_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 34.57 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.39 AND 9.52 AND d.d_year >= 1997.07 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 10654.33 ORDER BY l2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 84.82 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 574052.19 AND COUNT(*) > 75.94 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19926385 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 334) AND l.lo_revenue > 392842 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1997 AND p.p_size >= 28 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9530 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 2 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size >= 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 475250 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (lo.lo_orderdate + lo.lo_shippriority) = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND dd.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND p.p_size > 26 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, dd.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 345704 AND COUNT(*) > 42 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_datekey LIMIT 1311;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 225790.38 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 25.3 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.54 AND 2.77 AND d.d_year >= 1997.52 AND p.p_size > 47.29 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 251357.25 AND COUNT(*) > 34.63 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_supplycost) AS percentile_75_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.lo_supplycost), 0) * 100 AS profit_margin_pct FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1992 AND p.p_size >= 5 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 5 AND l.lo_quantity > 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 713864 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 445 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, profit_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 87189.65 AND dd.d_year >= 1995.49 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_quantity) > 311.48 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brands_purchased, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 10003.24 AND d.d_year >= 1992.76 AND d.d_year <= 1994.85 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 261.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_orderdate >= 19960323) AS avg_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 481647 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 891515.82 AND d.d_year >= 1995.55 AND d.d_year <= 1993.26 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 298592.31 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND l.lo_discount <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4622696 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 43799 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 111581 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN lineorder l ON s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 189144 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19935374 AND 19935882) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1470822 AND COUNT(*) >= 622 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 96980 ORDER BY c.c_nation, revenue_rank_in_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19960667 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 152002) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 41 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5231774 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 8730 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 42 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND p.p_size >= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8103665 AND COUNT(*) >= 297 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate AND lo_quantity > 31) AS max_extended_price_for_day FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 937957 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 29 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 17463 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1998 AND p.p_size > 38 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 18 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 19 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 541844 AND COUNT(*) > 845 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND p.p_size > 33 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 185311 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey WHERE l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19966314 AND 19930713 GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1431710 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 6 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 76538574 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(lo.lo_tax) AS max_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 1932891.79 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 93.67 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.83 AND 4.72 AND d.d_year >= 2018.53 AND p.p_size > 3.23 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3938737.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) > 498.04 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_nation LIKE 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_year >= 1996.43 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.56 AND 4.29 AND l.lo_quantity > 48.91 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8605380.31 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 AND l.lo_quantity > 38 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1999 AND p.p_size > 21 AND s.s_nation NOT IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2636379 AND COUNT(*) >= 846 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7330136 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 0 AND l.lo_quantity > 12 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 12 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 37951737 AND COUNT(*) > 675 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(l.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(l.lo_tax) AS max_tax FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 522554.32 AND l.lo_quantity BETWEEN 94.34 AND 17.69 AND d.d_year >= 1998.26 AND d.d_year <= 1998.06 AND p.p_size > 13.36 AND l.lo_discount < 3.74 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 57257300.73 AND COUNT(*) > 443.98 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 48 GROUP BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4217 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5419302 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3082033 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 537976 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 322656 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.39 AND 9.54 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 788673.12 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19924243 AND p.p_size > 8 AND dd.d_year IN (1996, 1998, 1993) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 555638 AND COUNT(*) >= 98 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost * lo.lo_quantity) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year >= 1998 AND d_year <= 1991 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND p.p_size > 32 AND lo.lo_quantity > ( SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_partkey = lo.lo_partkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19920573 AND 19972582 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5995681 AND COUNT(*) > 70 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 12 AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_size > 15 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 411308 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.lo_orderkey::text, '-', l.lo_linenumber::text)) AS distinct_line_items, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 97885.16 AND l.lo_quantity >= 67.96 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.51 AND 2.27 AND d.d_year >= 1992.79 AND p.p_size > 31.08 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 372925.71 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 792.21 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.2 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19937380 AND 19937326) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p90_extendedprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 823741 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 66 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 47 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 129728 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 31 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_quantity) DESC) AS quantity_rank_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 284916 AND l.lo_quantity >= 77 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 47 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1758613 AND COUNT(*) >= 854 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_nation_year SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 17 AND 29 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue * 0.5 ORDER BY lo2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 28 OFFSET 2 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 939024 AND COUNT(*) > 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_extended_price) FROM (SELECT lo_partkey, MAX(lo_extendedprice) AS max_extended_price FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19972850 GROUP BY lo_partkey HAVING MAX(lo_extendedprice) > 35691) sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey) AS max_part_extended_price_in_period FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(avg_rev) FROM (SELECT lo_custkey, AVG(lo_revenue) AS avg_rev FROM lineorder WHERE lo_commitdate <= 19936866 GROUP BY lo_custkey) inner_sub) AND COUNT(*) > 295 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 29 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 11 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 85710248 AND COUNT(*) >= 673 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue_3month, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 11 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_quantity > 29 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3825774 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY d.d_year, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1287639 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6077328 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19922171) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 807711 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 1535 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 1 AND l.lo_quantity > 36 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 30 AND s.s_nation NOT IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2672001 AND COUNT(*) >= 363 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 32518377 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3739643 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 47 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2101269 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_category = 'FURNITURE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 618875 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 17 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_supplycost) < 822 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l_inner.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l_inner WHERE l_inner.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l_inner.lo_orderdate >= 19945280 ) AS avg_quantity_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8470779 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 878350.17 AND l.lo_quantity >= 45.11 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.08 AND 19.12 AND d.d_year >= 1996.84 AND d.d_year <= 2004.11 AND p.p_size > 32.84 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CHINA', 'GERMANY') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 322841.9 AND COUNT(*) >= 420.61 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.lo_orderkey::text, '-', l.lo_linenumber::text)) AS distinct_line_items, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 452618.69 AND l.lo_quantity >= 49.12 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.89 AND 9.81 AND d.d_year >= 1996.92 AND d.d_year <= 1996.96 AND p.p_size > 14.72 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1134545.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 668.3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 4908.3;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year, dd.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 40 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 43 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9386904 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 19 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size >= 22 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 23838 AND COUNT(*) >= 959 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 51328 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 480817 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.32 AND 7.28 AND d.d_year >= 1997.95 AND p.p_size > 18.51 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 755138.86 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p90_extendedprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 743554 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 79 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1997 AND p.p_size > 10 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1971824 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) < 74858 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 476449.77 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 69.28 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.57 AND 1994.05 AND p.p_size > 12.41 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.18 AND 5.74 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 145011.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 80.35 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19946951 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 5590) AND l.lo_quantity > 22 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 54464999 AND COUNT(*) > 960 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 61;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size >= 34 AND p.p_size <= 28 AND (c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5180472 AND COUNT(*) >= 415 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS running_nation_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 9 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7672095 AND COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 24 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4862823 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, s.s_region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 4 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND l.lo_revenue > 7866 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1999 AND p.p_size > 33 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, s.s_region), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, s.s_region), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 245439 AND COUNT(*) >= 748 ORDER BY c.c_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 9 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 15104 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1997 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), (p.p_category, s.s_region), (d.d_year), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1995 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND p.p_size > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_size) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_category = p.p_category ) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8207437 ORDER BY c.c_region, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19953713 AND p.p_size > 39 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1992 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 44113519 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 503 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 3 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 28 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 44066781 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) > 213 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19962927 AND 19942264) AS revenue_diff_from_avg FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 62195008 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 499742.96 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 35.51 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.32 AND 2.7 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 2002.43 AND p.p_size > 7.32 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4312668.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 371.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_region AS cust1_region, c2.c_region AS cust2_region, p.p_category AS part_category, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2, AVG(l1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(l2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count_cust1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.lo_orderkey) AS order_count_cust2, SUM(l1.lo_quantity * l1.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost_cust1, SUM(l2.lo_quantity * l2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost_cust2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder l1 JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_partkey = l2.lo_partkey AND l1.lo_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey AND l1.lo_orderdate <> l2.lo_orderdate JOIN customer c1 ON l1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON l2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON l1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON l1.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d3 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d3.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d4 ON l2.lo_commitdate = d4.d_datekey WHERE l1.lo_revenue > 4258765.23 AND l2.lo_revenue > 6175366.52 AND l1.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l2.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1992.01 AND 1995.93 AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1995.2 AND 1996.07 AND p.p_size > 3.71 AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_region, c2.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d1.d_year, d2.d_year HAVING SUM(l1.lo_quantity) > 7625.43 AND SUM(l2.lo_quantity) > 1128.62 ORDER BY total_revenue_cust1 DESC, total_revenue_cust2 DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 940315.5 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19957255 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
