SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19966673) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 56701 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 348775 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(lo.lo_orderpriority) AS min_order_priority, MAX(lo.lo_shipmode) AS max_ship_mode, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity_for_brand FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_extendedprice > 30294.22 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 26.3 AND 90.22 AND d.d_year >= 1992.09 AND (c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING') AND p.p_brand1 SIMILAR TO 'Brand%1' AND s.s_region ~ 'AMERICA' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode LIKE 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate > 19939561.19) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 921755.1 AND COUNT(*) > 95.31 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5.2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 747001.6 AND l.lo_quantity >= 79.24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.66 AND 4.01 AND d.d_year >= 1997.86 AND d.d_year <= 1997.89 AND p.p_size > 34.86 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CHINA', 'GERMANY') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 395058.89 AND COUNT(*) >= 750.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_region_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 30 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 55658161 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_order_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year) AS segment_year_revenue, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19940671 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19966351 AND p.p_size > 25 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5650552 AND COUNT(*) >= 71 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1993 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9962 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 967777 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 18 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 17) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice < 22298 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 38 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA', 'BRAZIL')) AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Summer', 'Spring') AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE') AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 984784 AND COUNT(*) >= 543 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year ASC, s.s_region ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 43 AND dd.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size > 17 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3992820 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year, dd.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 39 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 43 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9913369 AND COUNT(*) > 423 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost * lo.lo_quantity) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND lo.lo_quantity > 6.81 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.56 AND 7.27 AND dd.d_year >= 1993.63 AND p.p_size > 15.57 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3735843.91 AND COUNT(*) >= 811.9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 64 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19976288 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19943528 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 0 AND p.p_size > 44 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 964789 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 806;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p90_extendedprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 329911 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 68 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 20 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4834987 AND COUNT(*) > 287 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 2032 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, s.s_nation ASC LIMIT 2027;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19958190 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 8931) AND l.lo_revenue > 765484 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1996 AND p.p_size >= 50 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 2276 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 1449 ORDER BY c.c_nation, d.d_year, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 6 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9669483 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 5 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1997 AND p.p_size > 19 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 12 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 29 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9177643 AND COUNT(*) > 887 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 633706.48 AND l.lo_quantity >= 64.9 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.38 AND 9.54 AND d.d_year >= 1992.96 AND p.p_size >= 35.54 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2886750.64 AND COUNT(*) > 54.1 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS p75_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND l.lo_discount <= 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5842383 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 16477731 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4957 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 305 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 2087 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3708 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 14 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2740434 UNION ALL SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_shippriority = 5 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 16 ORDER BY d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1994 AND d2.d_year <= 1994 ) AND l.lo_discount >= 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8781325 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 65742167 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND l.lo_discount <= 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 16984837 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19980681 AND 19952595) AS max_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 17 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 588838 AND COUNT(*) > 469 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year, s.s_region) AS cumulative_revenue_by_year_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 19 AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR', 'AIR') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5403225 AND AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 74 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY p.p_category, s.s_region) AS running_revenue_by_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 34 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate < 19940145) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6785774 AND COUNT(*) >= 8411 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1992 AND 1996 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 5 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 844839 ORDER BY order_year DESC, order_month DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 10 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3375030 ORDER BY order_year DESC, order_month DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_orderkey = lo2.lo_orderkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey AND dd.d_year >= 1992.37 AND lo1.lo_revenue > 16166.92 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 5.26 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, total_revenue_cust1 DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, p1.p_category AS part_category, p2.p_brand1 AS part_brand, s1.s_region AS supplier_region, s2.s_nation AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo1.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo1.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d1.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(lo1.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_custkey, p1.p_category ORDER BY d1.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey AND lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_orderdate < lo2.lo_commitdate JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p1 ON lo1.lo_partkey = p1.p_partkey JOIN part p2 ON lo2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey JOIN supplier s1 ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s1.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo2.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo1.lo_revenue > 985843.93 AND lo2.lo_supplycost > 9555.65 AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1993 AND c1.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p1.p_size >= 5 AND s1.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, p1.p_category, p2.p_brand1, s1.s_region, s2.s_nation, c1.c_region HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 6649.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) >= 40 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_year, cust1_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS segment_year_running_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 32 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 273172 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year) AS running_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 8.99 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.64 AND 4.01 AND d.d_year >= 1993.43 AND d.d_year <= 1996.18 AND p.p_size >= 24.82 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 581301.05 AND COUNT(*) > 480.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 14 AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'FURNITURE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 260597 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 36 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_supplycost) < 553 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 405123 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 494066 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 27 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 29380 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'AIR')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 8 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND dd.d_year <= 1994 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES') AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 254365 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 55 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND lo.lo_quantity > 34 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size >= 3 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'FRANCE', 'JAPAN') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8439227 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 25 AND p.p_size <= 39 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 18 AND lo.lo_revenue > 255352 AND c.c_custkey IN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey FROM lineorder lo_inner JOIN dim_date d_inner ON lo_inner.lo_orderdate = d_inner.d_datekey WHERE d_inner.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND lo_inner.lo_revenue > 251770 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey HAVING SUM(lo_inner.lo_quantity) > 7790 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3905819 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 492 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 367018 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 14 AND 57 AND lo.lo_discount >= 2 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND dd.d_year <= 1996 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'BUILDING', 'MACHINERY') AND p.p_size > 46 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = lo.lo_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 47771 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 459781 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 92 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 13 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 8421;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extended_price, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supply_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_line_count, SUM(lo.lo_tax) AS total_tax, MAX(lo.lo_commitdate) AS latest_commit_date_key, MIN(lo.lo_orderdate) AS earliest_order_date_key FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 9085107.66 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 43.41 AND 61.19 AND lo.lo_discount >= 6.67 AND dd.d_year >= 1997.7 AND dd.d_year <= 1993.95 AND p.p_size > 17.02 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3876999.81 AND COUNT(*) > 96.85 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 3 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_size > 47 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2094229 AND COUNT(*) >= 92 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 6 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= lo.lo_orderdate - 30 AND lo2.lo_orderdate <= lo.lo_orderdate + 30 AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue * 1.5 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 938642 AND COUNT(*) >= 231 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_quantity > 29) AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1996 AND p.p_size > 34 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND (lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' OR lo.lo_shipmode = 'TRUCK') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4278070 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 19 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year ASC, revenue_rank_in_segment_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS all_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lo.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY lo.lo_shipmode) AS all_shipmodes, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_commitdate) AS earliest_commit_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_extendedprice > 495390.82 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 7.29 AND 80.39 AND d.d_year >= 1994.69 AND p.p_size >= 39.19 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.54 AND 14.41 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 827227.08 AND COUNT(*) > 437.52 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7465.32;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19976073) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 601988 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND p.p_size > 43 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.17 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19939272 AND 19932678) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19964902 AND lo_orderdate <= 19958922) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = c.c_nation ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 263535 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.82 AND 6.89 AND d.d_year >= 1992.62 AND p.p_size > 10.91 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 53007.45 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND d.d_monthnuminyear IN (8, 1, 1) AND d.d_holidayfl = 1 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 556468 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19938279 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19923803 AND lo.lo_discount >= 10 AND lo.lo_discount <= 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 36 AND p.p_size > 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 297449 ORDER BY rolling_30day_revenue DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 8 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 39935 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'ASIA') AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND (p.p_size > 44 OR p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'MED BAG', 'LG BOX')) AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 681359 AND COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 41 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 26 AND s.s_region = (SELECT s2.s_region FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND s2.s_city = 'NEW YORK' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 88346918 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 286 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 254216.82 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 11.96 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1999.19 AND 2012.73 AND p.p_size > 3.41 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.02 AND 6.17 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 453871.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 14.3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_quantity DESC, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_discount) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19965958 AND 19975415) AS max_discount_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 1 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 397701 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 884201 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 41 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 50215565 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 882 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19957658) AS max_order_total_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 13 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 88482739 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 27 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS LAST, s.s_region NULLS LAST, p.p_category NULLS LAST, d.d_year NULLS LAST, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey, c1.c_name, c1.c_city, c2.c_custkey AS related_custkey, c2.c_name AS related_name, c2.c_city AS related_city, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN customer c2 ON c1.c_city = c2.c_city AND c1.c_custkey <> c2.c_custkey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON c2.c_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE dd1.d_year = 1992 AND dd2.d_year = 1994 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 28 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 36 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c1.c_name, c1.c_city, c2.c_custkey, c2.c_name, c2.c_city HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 227748 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7196 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19947134 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19958631 AND p.p_size > 25 AND lo.lo_quantity < 59 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 89071489 AND COUNT(*) >= 362 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1997) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 181877 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_commitdate) AS earliest_commit_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_qty_by_cust_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_extendedprice > 5814.06 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 17.95 AND 26.5 AND d.d_year >= 1996.5 AND (c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE%' OR c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING%') AND (p.p_type LIKE 'ECONOMY%' OR p.p_container LIKE 'SM%') AND (s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA%' OR s.s_nation LIKE 'UNITED%') AND lo.lo_discount < 4.95 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH', '3-MEDIUM') AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Winter%' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 933054.9 AND COUNT(*) >= 45.3 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) > 2.03 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, s.s_nation LIMIT 355.07;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 510746 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 518872 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19946456 AND 19954183) AS max_order_total_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 8 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 439557 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE 'AIR' AND p.p_type LIKE 'ECONOMY' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AFRICA' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND lo.lo_quantity > 47.22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.73 AND 0.44 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1996.11 AND 1993.33 AND lo.lo_revenue > 82352.17 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 259608.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 68.11 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 13 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 25 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 43972017 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 18 AND 12 AND lo.lo_commitdate >= 19937593 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1995 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19979885 AND 19947829) AND COUNT(*) > 960 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7660;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 26 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 35 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4932379 AND COUNT(*) > 624 ORDER BY dd.d_year DESC, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 6 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 93459836 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 1208;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 35 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size >= 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7334536 AND COUNT(*) >= 234 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;
