SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey, MAX(lo_inner.lo_orderdate) AS latest_order_date FROM lineorder lo_inner WHERE lo_inner.lo_quantity > 23 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey ) recent_orders ON lo.lo_custkey = recent_orders.lo_custkey AND lo.lo_partkey = recent_orders.lo_partkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19966408 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19952404 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 34 AND 15 AND lo.lo_discount >= 2 AND c.c_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND s.s_region = 'ASIA' AND lo.lo_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(lo_sub.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo_sub JOIN dim_date d_sub ON lo_sub.lo_orderdate = d_sub.d_datekey WHERE d_sub.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND lo_sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2962828 AND COUNT(*) > 926 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(lo.lo_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS last_order_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_category_time FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND lo.lo_quantity > 42.29 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 8432.85 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.9 AND 3.49 AND d.d_year >= 1996.57 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND d.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 3.43 AND 4.96 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 14.63 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 868090.73 AND COUNT(*) > 75.0 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 0.46 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 94300 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE dd.d_year >= 1998 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 745362 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 20 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 AND lo.lo_revenue > 470804 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1993 AND p.p_size >= 26 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 86587 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 88 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3004;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 12 AND d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_size > 35 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 154908 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extended_price, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_discount) AS p75_discount, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND lo.lo_quantity > 48 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 0 AND p.p_size >= 9 AND p.p_size <= 28 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4466945 AND COUNT(*) >= 55 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_tax) AS total_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS grand_total, AVG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue_4period FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 20 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 7473 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 36 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 978494 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 88 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 27.65 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.08 AND 3.27 AND d.d_year >= 1995.57 AND p.p_size > 33.46 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 812863.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 31.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19928024 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19948157 AND p.p_size >= 22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6049776 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 488 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19935397 AND 19946245) AS max_extended_price_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND l.lo_quantity > 7 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1189099 AND COUNT(*) >= 46 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1998 AND d2.d_year <= 1995 AND d2.d_sellingseason IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d3.d_sellingseason FROM dim_date d3 WHERE d3.d_year = 1993 AND d3.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 10 AND 9 ) ) AND l.lo_quantity > 12 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND p.p_size >= 31 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > ( SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) * 1.94 FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_orderdate >= 19971156 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19970987 ) AND COUNT(*) > 591 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 84 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 22 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6440253 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 22 AND dd.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 25 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2814389 AND COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_region, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 826543.35 AND l.lo_quantity >= 58.25 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.06 AND 6.55 AND d.d_year >= 1994.94 AND p.p_size > 35.98 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 114275.22 AND COUNT(*) > 12.89 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year LIMIT 7135.22;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 47 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19921792 AND 19970795) ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_discount_for_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 813206.59 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 43 AND 16 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8795.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_discount) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19942948 AND 19934449) AS max_discount_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 4 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 34 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 330799 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 6 AND l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' ) GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 973578 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 92971362 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount >= 3 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 49 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3721400 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 92476.2 AND l.lo_quantity >= 3.55 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.94 AND 8.65 AND d.d_year >= 1993.93 AND p.p_size >= 5.46 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1607313.75 AND COUNT(*) > 731.78 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS p75_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND l.lo_discount <= 6 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1603530 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7938 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_suppkey IN ( SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_region = 'AMERICA' ) AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 75477896 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 15 AND l.lo_quantity > 19 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size IN (21, 32, 9) AND s.s_region = c.c_region GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 123138 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brand_list FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.27 AND 1.76 AND d.d_year >= 1996.24 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7070.55 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 46 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1987807 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '-' || lo.lo_linenumber::text) AS unique_line_items, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 7387.25 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 4.78 AND 16.07 AND d.d_year >= 1992.02 AND p.p_size > 24.53 AND lo.lo_discount < 3.91 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1809240.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 565.63 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19955766 AND 19925751) AS max_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 4 AND p.p_size > 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6936136 AND COUNT(*) > 338 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19943876) AS max_extended_price_for_part_supplier FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 27 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey, l.lo_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 88064295 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 84726731 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 32 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7564597 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 49 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1612597 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 1 AND l.lo_quantity > 19 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size IN (15, 10, 34) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4928456 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, CASE WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 17107038.4 THEN 'HIGH_REVENUE' WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) BETWEEN 602411.94 AND 747768.65 THEN 'MEDIUM_REVENUE' ELSE 'LOW_REVENUE' END AS revenue_category, CASE WHEN AVG(l.lo_discount) > 14.92 THEN 'HIGH_DISCOUNT' ELSE 'NORMAL_DISCOUNT' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY s.s_region) AS prev_revenue_by_category_year_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 30.56 AND l.lo_extendedprice >= 47287.52 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994.4 AND 1993.16 AND p.p_size IN (26.48, 12.8, 17.4) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 174739.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 265.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, s.s_region LIMIT 8734.81;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 24 AND 13 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1998 AND l.lo_commitdate <= l.lo_orderdate + 69 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 48610782 AND COUNT(*) >= 934 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 669241 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 67485631 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 211190.84 AND lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19963083.96 AND 19941458.98 AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.77 AND 8.83 AND p.p_size IN (SELECT p2.p_size FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_color LIKE 'almond' GROUP BY p2.p_size HAVING COUNT(*) > 17.9) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 10861.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 34.72 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 112.64;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 19 AND p.p_size <= 23 AND lo.lo_discount >= 4 AND lo.lo_discount <= 2 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND dd.d_year <= 1997 AND lo.lo_commitdate >= 19972327 AND lo.lo_commitdate <= 19921539 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 78621327 AND COUNT(*) >= 85 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size >= 40 AND p.p_size <= 29 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND dd.d_year <= 1996 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 16148753 AND COUNT(*) >= 364 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 7299;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_customer_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 12 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') AND p.p_size > 35 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7593066 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 258;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue_per_order, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_quantity) AS high_quantity_threshold FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 839269 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_by_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_orderkey = l2.lo_orderkey AND l.lo_linenumber < l2.lo_linenumber WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 14 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND l.lo_quantity > 50 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7166715 AND COUNT(*) >= 758 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size > 36 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 373889 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1993 AND p.p_size >= 36 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 0 AND l.lo_quantity > 70 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5500812 AND COUNT(*) >= 64 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.14 AND 5.53 AND d.d_year = 1992.87 AND p.p_size > 18.82 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 276255.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l.lo_orderdate = l2.lo_orderdate WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.69 AND 1.9 AND d.d_year >= 1994.57 AND p.p_size > 21.72 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 433620.94 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON l.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (l.lo_orderdate + l.lo_shippriority) = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 8 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 9 AND dd_commit.d_holidayfl = 0 AND dd_ship.d_weekdayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, dd.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9764848 AND COUNT(*) > 871 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_datekey LIMIT 8349;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 627422.51 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 3.79 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.7 AND 3.6 AND d.d_year >= 1993.06 AND p.p_size > 32.12 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 155976.97 AND COUNT(*) > 15.55 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 22 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19928871) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9426710 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_weeknuminyear, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, MIN(lo.lo_commitdate) AS earliest_commit_date, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS latest_order_date, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month) AS prev_month_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 46 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 16270 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND d.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 2 AND 2 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 47 AND 3 AND p.p_color IN ('almond', 'almond', 'almond') AND s.s_region IN ('AFRICA', 'AFRICA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_weeknuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 809256 AND COUNT(*) > 79 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, revenue_rank_in_region_year;
