SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1997 AND p.p_size >= 33 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND lo.lo_quantity > 12 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_region = 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2201939 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 133 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN supplier s2 ON s.s_region = s2.s_region AND s.s_nation <> s2.s_nation JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate = lo.lo_orderdate WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.77 AND 9.36 AND lo.lo_quantity > 40.97 AND d.d_year >= 1992.5 AND p.p_size > 19.56 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 50932733.49 AND COUNT(*) >= 135.8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19963852 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19954492 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 11 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN supplier s2 ON l2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND s2.s_nation = s.s_nation AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19941716 AND 19948768 AND l2.lo_quantity > 67 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l3.lo_orderpriority = 'URGENT' AND l3.lo_orderdate >= 19952386 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3752670 AND COUNT(*) >= 815 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 9878;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS running_nation_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 41 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 34 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6100745 AND COUNT(*) >= 135 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS low_disc_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_quantity > 12 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1803414 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7043571 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS p75_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 91617.38 AND d.d_year >= 1993.39 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 152446.53 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND l.lo_discount <= 6 AND p.p_size > 36 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 32286127 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 22 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6900858 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount >= 1 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_quantity > 16 THEN l.lo_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_quantity_sales, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1993 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4259407 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8549 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_discount_for_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount > 4 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 4 AND 14 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9048793 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4855 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brand_list FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.57 AND 2.23 AND d.d_year >= 1997.84 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 5395.47 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6979992 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 6 AND l.lo_quantity > 17 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size IN (45, 6, 46) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8713734 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 11 AND 17 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1993 AND l.lo_commitdate <= l.lo_orderdate + 35 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 20019031 AND COUNT(*) >= 571 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(l.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(l.lo_tax) AS max_tax FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 7259667.41 AND l.lo_quantity BETWEEN 42.2 AND 87.0 AND d.d_year >= 1998.05 AND d.d_year <= 1997.05 AND p.p_size > 6.17 AND l.lo_discount < 3.7 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 28559656.18 AND COUNT(*) > 383.32 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19923785 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 71478.54 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1996.36 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 25.67 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1997 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 894695 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 818028 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 46 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 44 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'BUILDING', 'FURNITURE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1258889 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 24 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_nation LIMIT 9067;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year) AS segment_year_total_revenue, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year), 0)) * 100 AS revenue_percentage_of_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 97.93 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.27 AND 4.11 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1996.39 AND 1996.8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 92475634.72 AND COUNT(*) >= 326.95 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year LIMIT 6857.22;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_sellingseason, p.p_category ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 33.49 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.08 AND 1.08 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1992.61 AND 1994.84 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 20913540.15 AND COUNT(*) >= 596.97 ORDER BY dd.d_year DESC, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo INNER JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19957463 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19963822 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 AND p.p_size > 40 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 82063289 AND COUNT(*) >= 577 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 3402;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost * lo.lo_quantity) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year >= 1994 AND d_year <= 1995 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND p.p_size > 25 AND lo.lo_quantity > ( SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_partkey = lo.lo_partkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19925376 AND 19929300 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1148899 AND COUNT(*) > 24 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue_per_order, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_quantity) AS high_quantity_threshold FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 29 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 587760 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 370724.08 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 36.44 AND p.p_size <= 32.68 AND l.lo_discount >= 8.71 AND l.lo_discount <= 2.54 AND d.d_year >= 1995.88 AND d.d_year <= 1992.84 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1291640.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 92.16 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, s.s_nation ASC LIMIT 6005.93;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1993 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' ) AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 13 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 516547 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4612016 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 768539 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 975 ORDER BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 72 AND dd.d_year >= 2013 AND p.p_size > 19 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.45 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_suppkey IN (SELECT s2.s_suppkey FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = s.s_region)) AND COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 9807;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 12 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 17056 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1997 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue ORDER BY l2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 23 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 401875 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = '1992-01-01') = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 8017763.62 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19979489.86 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 11.52 AND 17.87 AND (dd.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' OR dd.d_sellingseason IS NULL) AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'AMERICA') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_discount < 5.62 AND lo.lo_quantity > 81.89 AND dd_commit.d_yearmonthnum = 199540.64 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2137723.76 AND COUNT(*) >= 939.59 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, dd.d_year LIMIT 6523.42;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 47 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 67346 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19933968 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 6546) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 38 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5280314 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 1819 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_discount) AS pct_75_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 31 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1992 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 156616 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4524105.9 THEN 'High Revenue' WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) BETWEEN 595800.61 AND 798893.43 THEN 'Medium Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.12 AND 3.94 AND d.d_year >= 1994.42 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) > 98.69 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 2 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 57062278 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_rev) FROM (SELECT d2.d_year, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS max_rev FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE d2.d_year = d.d_year GROUP BY d2.d_year) sub) AS max_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 12 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1537445 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 1 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1996 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 43.08 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.17 AND 7.99 AND d.d_year >= 1995.49 AND d.d_year <= 2004.51 AND p.p_size > 8.71 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7251104.75 AND COUNT(*) > 957.69 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS grand_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 3 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19969768 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19933616 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 11 AND d.d_holidayfl = 0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 55419346 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 898 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS p75_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 41288.01 AND d.d_year >= 1997.09 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 474859.75 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 8 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 71513098 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 968661 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey WHERE l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19927905 AND 19952151 GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6328989 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3703851 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region), (d.d_year), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT (l.lo_orderkey, l.lo_linenumber)) AS distinct_order_lines, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 31.7 AND d.d_year >= 1996.46 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 17.71 AND 45.18 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 729368.27 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 230050 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1994 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 295649 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992.13 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.32 AND 13.25 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name UNION ALL SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l.lo_quantity > 99.76 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 797927 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 34 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1978175 AND COUNT(*) > 245 ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.35 AND 6.97 AND d.d_year = 1996.67 AND p.p_size > 40.05 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 975894.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount >= 4 AND l.lo_discount <= 1 AND p.p_size > 47 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 640238 ORDER BY d.d_year, p.p_category, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19966850) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 915331 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l_inner.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l_inner WHERE l_inner.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l_inner.lo_orderdate >= 19921043 ) AS avg_quantity_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 857596 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_orderdate >= 19978762) AS avg_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 278725 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.8 AND 9.19 AND d.d_year = 1997.2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s JOIN lineorder l2 ON s.s_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey WHERE s.s_nation = c.c_nation AND l2.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 710289.1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE (l.lo_discount > 2.96 AND l.lo_quantity < 6.64) OR (l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1994.17 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' )) OR (p.p_size > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_size) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_category = p.p_category )) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 903607.27 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 84.08;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19980563 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 909164 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1990 AND d2.d_year <= 1992 AND d2.d_sellingseason IN ( SELECT DISTINCT d3.d_sellingseason FROM dim_date d3 WHERE d3.d_year = 1990 AND d3.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 1 AND 11 ) ) AND l.lo_quantity > 7 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 0 AND p.p_size >= 50 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > ( SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) * 1.04 FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_orderdate >= 19958976 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19931783 ) AND COUNT(*) > 408 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 22 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 18061 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1992 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 437200 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19970919 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND p.p_size > 7 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 674798 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_discount) AS p75_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_quantity > 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 157508 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.lo_orderkey::text, '-', l.lo_linenumber::text)) AS distinct_line_items, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 752312.54 AND l.lo_quantity >= 95.61 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.64 AND 6.43 AND d.d_year >= 1996.51 AND d.d_year <= 1995.72 AND p.p_size > 31.98 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 128480.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 216.77 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1648.91;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts_ordered, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers_used, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 402815.21 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 49.46 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.84 AND 16.8 AND dd.d_year >= 1994.09 AND p.p_size > 25.92 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 473602.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 93.22 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 87 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 18 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 973340 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 85 AND dd.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 10 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19977660 AND 19949398 AND lo2.lo_discount > 2) AND COUNT(*) > 56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 1829;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 40 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 228574 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 41 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_mktsegment ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_by_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_orderkey = l2.lo_orderkey AND l.lo_linenumber < l2.lo_linenumber WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1992 AND p.p_size >= 13 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND l.lo_quantity > 58 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9609442 AND COUNT(*) >= 675 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 10.23 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 9374.12 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997.79 AND 1993.01 ) OR ( l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.46 AND 5.79 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#12' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= l.lo_orderdate - 30 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= l.lo_orderdate + 30 AND l2.lo_revenue > 61161.76 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l3.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND d2.d_holidayfl = 1 AND d2.d_year = d.d_year ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 439494.41 AND COUNT(*) > 90.67 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 174.7;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l.lo_orderdate < l2.lo_orderdate JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND l.lo_quantity > 84 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 15 AND l2.lo_quantity > 83 AND d2.d_year = d.d_year + 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9044933 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 66 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1992 AND p.p_size >= 3 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND l.lo_quantity > 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3217345 AND COUNT(*) >= 409 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.65 AND 3.72 AND d.d_year = 1994.07 AND p.p_size > 7.85 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 634972.93 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 50 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 21 AND 41 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 982569 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount >= 2 AND l.lo_discount <= 8 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 402284 ORDER BY d.d_year, p.p_category, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND p.p_size > 24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19959486 AND 19957052) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = c.c_nation ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 364791 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
