SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1994 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND p.p_size > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_size) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_category = p.p_category ) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6287636 ORDER BY c.c_region, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 12 AND p.p_size > 48 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 40000288 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount >= 8 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_quantity > 31 THEN l.lo_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_quantity_sales, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6047558 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7358 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4688177 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8103886 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 0 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3440 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5368514 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_size > 38 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2162759 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19923642 AND 19946283) AS max_quantity_for_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND p.p_size > 11 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND s.s_nation IN (SELECT s2.s_nation FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = 'AMERICA') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9735490 AND COUNT(*) > 311 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 62021531 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND s.s_nation LIKE 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_year >= 1997.42 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 94803565.34 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8452379 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand%' AND s.s_nation LIKE '%' AND d.d_year >= 1992.59 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.77 AND 6.38 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8652921.52 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 3 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 48 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1551179 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, CASE WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 60733790.1 THEN 'HIGH_REVENUE' WHEN SUM(l.lo_revenue) BETWEEN 574132.44 AND 768660.36 THEN 'MEDIUM_REVENUE' ELSE 'LOW_REVENUE' END AS revenue_category, CASE WHEN AVG(l.lo_discount) > 8.6 THEN 'HIGH_DISCOUNT' ELSE 'NORMAL_DISCOUNT' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY s.s_region) AS prev_revenue_by_category_year_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 27.19 AND l.lo_extendedprice >= 24903.51 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.25 AND 1992.06 AND p.p_size IN (15.23, 24.09, 30.74) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 475779.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 925.66 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, s.s_region LIMIT 9797.69;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 47 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3292065 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6358898 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, p1.p_category AS part_category, p2.p_brand1 AS part_brand, s1.s_region AS supplier_region, s2.s_nation AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo1.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo1.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d1.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey AND lo1.lo_partkey <> lo2.lo_partkey JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p1 ON lo1.lo_partkey = p1.p_partkey JOIN part p2 ON lo2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey JOIN supplier s1 ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s1.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo2.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo1.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo1.lo_quantity > 38.22 AND lo1.lo_extendedprice > 11394.02 AND lo1.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo2.lo_commitdate <= '19920101' AND p1.p_size BETWEEN 4.25 AND 26.72 AND p2.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG') AND c1.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s1.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d1.d_year >= 1997.2 AND d2.d_year <= 1996.53 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, p1.p_category, p2.p_brand1, s1.s_region, s2.s_nation, c1.c_region HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 147244.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) >= 86.16 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 17439.19 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1995.95 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 19.94 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 23618.92 AND d.d_year >= 1996.51 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 44.53 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19966626) AS recent_orders_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 581392 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_per_combo FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 338166.0 AND l.lo_quantity >= 53.84 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.6 AND 3.3 AND d.d_year >= 2015.91 AND p.p_size > 6.99 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 113538.79 AND COUNT(*) > 197.07 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_name ASC LIMIT 30.76;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 29 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND p.p_size > 28 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1998946 AND COUNT(*) > 641 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 60 AND dd.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 5 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 122339 AND COUNT(*) >= 242 ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 24 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 269537 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 491507 AND l.lo_quantity >= 64 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 15 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 476964 AND COUNT(*) > 19 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19967960 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19945268 AND p.p_size >= 2 AND ( l.lo_discount > 4 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19953306 AND 19949191 AND l2.lo_revenue > 428970 ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 24720 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1992 AND p.p_size >= 26 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5598655 AND COUNT(*) >= 67 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS grand_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 28 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19953994 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19972427 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 20 AND d.d_holidayfl = 0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 96115241 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 76 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_discount > 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_quantity > 34 THEN lo.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_quantity_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 966117 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 923 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND p.p_size > 33 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2785657 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 390766 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 471686 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8630135 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 517077 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 13 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1433992 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19944050) AS max_order_total_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 95836603 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7191396 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 49 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3444738 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS region_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 31 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1994 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, order_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, order_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (c.c_region), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 574818 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, order_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (s.s_region, p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 34092835 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 615941 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 29 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 39 AND 48 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1995 AND lo.lo_discount >= 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 20 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3633414 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 9 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 30 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 57992 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'RAIL')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 11 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA')) AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND dd.d_holidayfl = 0 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' OR lo.lo_shippriority > 0) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 974966 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 20 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year ASC, revenue_rank_in_segment_year ASC LIMIT 623;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 295899.88 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 51.26 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.26 AND 1.22 AND dd.d_year >= 1991.06 AND p.p_size > 23.92 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3229114.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 95.76 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 9.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 46 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 745318 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19959727 AND p.p_size > 36 AND dd.d_year IN (1996, 1996, 1997) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 41448 AND COUNT(*) >= 74 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue_per_order, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 788558 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS shipmodes_used, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS colors_ordered, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 12 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size >= 7 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4110791 AND COUNT(*) >= 269 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 6319;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19981141 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19922576 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND p.p_size > 28 AND d.d_year IN (1997, 1994, 1997) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4375158 AND COUNT(*) >= 504 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 726;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND dd.d_year = 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2782309 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 1.56 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.28 AND 19.13 AND d.d_year >= 1995.0 AND d.d_year <= 2000.83 AND p.p_size > 27.87 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6681748.63 AND COUNT(*) > 127.09 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND l.lo_quantity > 37 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1997 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year), (s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 51418690 AND COUNT(*) >= 697 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 963429 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount >= 8 AND l.lo_discount <= 8 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6919595 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9940 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS cust1_total_revenue, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS cust2_total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(lo2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_suppkey = lo2.lo_suppkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey AND c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE dd1.d_year >= 1997 AND dd2.d_year <= 1995 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 14 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 22 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 10 AND SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 172021 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, cust1_total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995.4 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.52 AND 8.56 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name UNION ALL SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l.lo_quantity > 71.69 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19923525 AND 19920520) AS max_order_total_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 0 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 840124 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 4 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 16) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice < 30164 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 35 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA', 'BRAZIL')) AND dd.d_year >= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Summer', 'Spring') AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE') AND lo.lo_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 893559 AND COUNT(*) >= 845 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 15 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year ASC, s.s_region ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo INNER JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 9 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 32 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 94171103 AND COUNT(*) > 696 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 5001;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l2.lo_discount) AS avg_related_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l1 ON c.c_custkey = l1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_partkey = l2.lo_partkey AND l1.lo_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND l1.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region HAVING SUM(l1.lo_revenue) > 278807 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 6542302.26 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 45.79 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996.3 AND 1992.15 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3281728.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 62.14 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 268.31;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 22 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 12 AND (c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7722813 AND COUNT(*) >= 835 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 28 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 689665 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND p.p_size > 2 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 32793122 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 999 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_year, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7429 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 18384.21 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1997.23 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 17.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1995 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 855006 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1998) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 463330 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19933255) AS recent_order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 462438 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 665704.8 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 23.36 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.66 AND 1.82 AND d.d_year >= 1997.63 AND d.d_year <= 1992.37 AND p.p_size > 5.85 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 194817.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 16.36 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 12 AND dd.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size > 1 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2899525 AND COUNT(*) >= 160 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;
