SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3382755 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 19 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 556247 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 644810 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_rev) FROM (SELECT d2.d_year, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS max_rev FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey GROUP BY d2.d_year) sub WHERE sub.d_year = d.d_year) AS max_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 7 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2782822 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 433690 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 31 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3509053 AND COUNT(*) >= 914 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 39 AND l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' ) GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9681371 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4756121 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 459336.53 AND l.lo_quantity >= 99.86 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.06 AND 1.37 AND d.d_year >= 1992.62 AND d.d_year <= 1993.67 AND p.p_size > 1.98 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 170918.33 AND COUNT(*) >= 181.67 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 95199138 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3514 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.53 AND 3.51 AND l.lo_orderpriority LIKE '1-URGENT' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1995.03 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 96440650.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 216.11 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, total_revenue DESC, order_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '|' || lo.lo_linenumber) AS distinct_order_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19970743 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19978726 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND p.p_size >= 41 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 67393585 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '|' || lo.lo_linenumber) >= 625843 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 34 AND lo.lo_quantity < 69 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 36505904 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 487 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4169650 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 75286302 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 8 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1877026 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 15 AND l.lo_quantity > 82 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 14 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 724082 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year, s.s_region) AS cumulative_revenue_by_year_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 11 AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR', 'AIR') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4373510 AND AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 15 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 50 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19954959 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 64806.78 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1992.95 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 36.59 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 95924.8 AND d.d_year >= 1994.17 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 13.57 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 13 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3845879 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1373019 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19952600) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19960403) AS avg_recent_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 914493 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 13 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 415078 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1993.88 AND d.d_year <= 1995.14 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.78 AND 1.67 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 847066.06 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 28 AND p.p_size <= 30 AND lo.lo_discount >= 9 AND lo.lo_discount <= 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 33 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8307222 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 65 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 935838 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 30 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1559140 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 45 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year, dd.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 89 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 8 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7994472 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 36 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 31 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5209101 AND COUNT(*) >= 970 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.41 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19923537 AND 19941898) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_supplycost) AS percentile_75_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.lo_supplycost), 0) * 100 AS profit_margin_pct FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 11 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND l.lo_quantity > 38 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3667834 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 448 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, profit_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l2.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l1 ON c.c_custkey = l1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l1.lo_orderdate = l2.lo_orderdate JOIN dim_date d ON l1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l1.lo_revenue > 17684.56 AND d.d_year >= 1992.62 AND p.p_size > 24.58 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l1.lo_revenue) > 158458.74 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND p.p_size > 34 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 56833890 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4914874 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3322 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND l.lo_discount >= 5 AND l.lo_discount <= 2 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8573502 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 5116 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 7309 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category) AS avg_category_revenue_per_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9405 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON p2.p_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9947429 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 74635514 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY p.p_category) AS running_revenue_by_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate IN (SELECT lo_commitdate FROM lineorder WHERE lo_supplycost > 3725 GROUP BY lo_commitdate HAVING COUNT(*) > 65)) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 23384552 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19972078 AND 19969149) AS revenue_diff_from_avg FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 29905774 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON p2.p_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = d.d_year) GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price_in_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6008755 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 39 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7606702 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8753090 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, p1.p_category AS part_category, p2.p_brand1 AS part_brand, s1.s_region AS supplier_region, s2.s_nation AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo1.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo1.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d1.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey AND lo1.lo_partkey <> lo2.lo_partkey JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p1 ON lo1.lo_partkey = p1.p_partkey JOIN part p2 ON lo2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey JOIN supplier s1 ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s1.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo2.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo1.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo1.lo_quantity > 49.25 AND lo1.lo_extendedprice > 45027.94 AND lo1.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo2.lo_commitdate <= '19920101' AND p1.p_size BETWEEN 28.15 AND 45.58 AND p2.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG') AND c1.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s1.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d1.d_year >= 1993.88 AND d2.d_year <= 1994.01 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, p1.p_category, p2.p_brand1, s1.s_region, s2.s_nation, c1.c_region HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 351327.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) >= 76.2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 68196.04 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 99.12 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996.6 AND 1996.29 AND p.p_size > 20.13 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 126438.9 AND COUNT(*) > 10.07 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_per_combo FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 654045.98 AND l.lo_quantity >= 17.56 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.16 AND 3.46 AND d.d_year >= 2008.24 AND p.p_size > 13.89 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 333657.49 AND COUNT(*) > 49.92 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_name ASC LIMIT 458.56;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.d_year, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year, p.p_category) AS cumulative_revenue_by_year_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 43 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9581251 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 31 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 841606 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 58 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19955103 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19947269 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND p.p_size > 18 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 842904 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 2541;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19930821) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 319901 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_orderdate >= 19940983) AS avg_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 584692 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 975 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 27 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 708 ORDER BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19964154 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19980955 AND lo.lo_discount >= 3 AND lo.lo_discount <= 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 81 AND p.p_size > 11 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 174666 ORDER BY rolling_30day_revenue DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19969624 AND 19968969) AS max_extended_price_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND l.lo_quantity > 31 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 8 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 22926100 AND COUNT(*) >= 783 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 5601;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 53477 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue, MAX(lo.lo_quantity) AS max_quantity, MIN(lo.lo_tax) AS min_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 140727.68 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 49.39 AND 27.03 AND d.d_year >= 1998.79 AND p.p_size > 41.87 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') AND lo.lo_discount < 7.09 AND (lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' OR lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 359936.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 81.7 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 211.5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 368.41;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1992 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND (d.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 OR d.d_holidayfl = 1) AND lo.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate + 19 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND p.p_size >= 27 AND s.s_region != c.c_region AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN d.d_datekey - 63 AND d.d_datekey - 1 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 7863 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 142155 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 30 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 849;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19954564 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19978237 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 80 AND p.p_size > 32 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 321537 AND COUNT(*) >= 755 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 7789;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_season_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1994 AND d2.d_year <= 1994 AND d2.d_sellingseason = ANY( SELECT DISTINCT d3.d_sellingseason FROM dim_date d3 WHERE d3.d_year = d2.d_year AND d3.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 5 AND 12 ) ) AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND p.p_size >= 47 AND s.s_nation IN ( SELECT s2.s_nation FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = 'AMERICA' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7066079 AND COUNT(*) > 892 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 2213;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 488 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_in_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 376264.76 AND l.lo_quantity >= 85.42 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.8 AND 2.08 AND d.d_year >= 1992.61 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Fall') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 17510.96 AND COUNT(*) >= 97.18 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 943808 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND l.lo_discount <= 0 AND p.p_size > 49 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 270535 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size > 44 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3615890 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 6 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 19 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1780216 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust_key1, c2.c_custkey AS cust_key2, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey AND dd1.d_year = 1997 AND dd2.d_year = 1994 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 10 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 25 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 13 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, total_revenue_cust1 DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 31 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2478027 AND COUNT(*) >= 346 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_supplycost) < 2665 AND MAX(l.lo_tax) <= 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19959254 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND p.p_size > 41 AND d.d_year = 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 888470 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount >= 6 AND l.lo_discount <= 5 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 392876 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo.lo_tax) AS total_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 63.04 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.93 AND 3.08 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992.3 AND 1992.38 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d2.d_datekey) FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1996.13 AND d2.d_month LIKE '%') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 628771370.45 AND COUNT(*) >= 65.71 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 3166.09;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 7 AND 38 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1993 AND lo.lo_discount >= 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 19 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4198938 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 31 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 13 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 5 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 30567644 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts_ordered, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers_used, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 237178.98 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 37.32 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.63 AND 1.18 AND dd.d_year >= 1994.71 AND p.p_size > 20.74 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 72438.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 29.87 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'RAIL') AND lo.lo_quantity > 2 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue * 0.5 ORDER BY lo2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 181 ) AND p.p_size > 35 AND s.s_region != 'ASIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4281702 AND COUNT(*) > 196 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year) AS segment_year_total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND lo.lo_quantity > 10.16 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.23 AND 8.59 AND dd.d_year >= 1994.26 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19928323.27 AND lo2.lo_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(lo3.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LIMIT 1 OFFSET 622.4 ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8395287.59 AND COUNT(*) > 861.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 818915.58 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 34.36 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.1 AND 14.63 AND dd.d_year >= 1990.03 AND p.p_size > 22.92 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CHINA', 'GERMANY') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 12446.0 AND COUNT(*) > 814.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 755283.78 AND l.lo_quantity >= 16.45 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995.32 AND 1995.56 AND p.p_size > 29.82 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.39 AND 5.71 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 801034.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 681.88 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, p.p_category LIMIT 5098.87;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l_inner.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l_inner WHERE l_inner.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l_inner.lo_orderdate >= 19932562 ) AS avg_quantity_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 880074 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_discount > 0.87) AS high_discount_orders FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996.22 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 343.45 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND d.d_year = 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nation = c.c_nation LIMIT 1 OFFSET 355 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 116705 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 1306 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c2 ON c.c_nation = c2.c_nation AND c.c_custkey <> c2.c_custkey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 39 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 941094 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 40.07 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.68 AND 2.67 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 30449.66 AND d.d_year >= 1993.92 AND d.d_year <= 1992.1 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 19.47 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 508958.21 AND COUNT(*) > 610.93 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 32 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 107 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_quantity) AS high_quantity_percentile, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 215500 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 913 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_region, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 15 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 2013 AND p.p_size > 4 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 55022744 AND COUNT(*) > 75 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year LIMIT 3267;
