SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 324845 ORDER BY d.d_year, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 286821 ORDER BY d.d_year, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 36 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 17017 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'RAIL')) ) AND NOT (lo.lo_orderpriority = '5-LOW' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region = 'EUROPE') AND (p.p_size > 10 OR p.p_color IN ('RED', 'BLUE', 'GREEN')) AND lo.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate + 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 149341 AND COUNT(*) >= 95 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_nation ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(lo.lo_tax) AS max_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 5665274.42 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 90.62 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995.13 AND 1996.71 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 9.1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 859962.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 363.71 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 2779.28;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue_3month FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 37 AND p.p_size <= 8 AND l.lo_discount >= 3 AND l.lo_discount <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 79089447 AND COUNT(*) > 121 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 9 AND s.s_region != 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19931546 AND 19927326) AND COUNT(*) > 701 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 42 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 45 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 86064026 AND COUNT(*) >= 830 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 21 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 335527 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 30 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 28 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19942206 AND 19938773 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 556630 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4427888 AND COUNT(*) > 90 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 41 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 39 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19943858 AND 19964030 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 229127 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8741154 AND COUNT(*) > 965 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_national_revenue_by_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN (SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey, MAX(lo_inner.lo_orderdate) AS latest_order_date FROM lineorder lo_inner GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey) recent_orders ON c.c_custkey = recent_orders.lo_custkey JOIN (SELECT p_inner.p_category, AVG(p_inner.p_size) AS avg_category_size FROM part p_inner GROUP BY p_inner.p_category) category_sizes ON p.p_category = category_sizes.p_category WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19955544 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19937855 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 2 AND p.p_size > 11 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND c.c_nation IN ('ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA') AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 22685409 AND COUNT(*) >= 72 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_sellingseason LIMIT 8033;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 7 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2684126 AND COUNT(*) >= 183 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 1 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND d1.d_year >= 1996 AND d2.d_year <= 1992 AND lo.lo_partkey IN (SELECT p2.p_partkey FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 3 AND p2.p_brand1 IN ('MFGR#11', 'MFGR#11')) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 70628687 AND COUNT(*) >= 629 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 42 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 337062 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 39 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 22009365 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7588886 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND d.d_year = 1996 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3411289 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.s_nation, ', ' ORDER BY s.s_nation) AS supplier_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 14360075 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 38976283 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4212 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 2378 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7050248 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1993.58 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 612618.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1205543 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 481832 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 21 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3928507 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.71 AND 4.68 AND d.d_year >= 1993.6 AND p.p_size > 5.4 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2707619.75 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(l.lo_discount) AS min_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_region_pair, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year)) AS revenue_year_over_year_change FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 15 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 29 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 19034881 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 569 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_region AS cust1_region, c2.c_region AS cust2_region, d.d_year AS order_year, d.d_sellingseason AS selling_season, p.p_category AS part_category, s.s_region AS supplier_region, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS cust1_total_revenue, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS cust2_total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(lo2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity_cust2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_suppkey = lo2.lo_suppkey AND lo1.lo_orderdate = lo2.lo_orderdate AND lo1.lo_custkey < lo2.lo_custkey JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE lo1.lo_revenue > 758394.19 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 4436.77 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997.68 AND 1992.86 AND p.p_size >= 31.47 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_region, c2.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 92.0 AND SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) > SUM(lo2.lo_quantity) ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, cust1_total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19943150 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 8882.67 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1997.8 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 69.44 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 525754.35 AND d.d_year >= 1993.28 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 68.51 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1997 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 384250 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 301621 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 15 AND d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 795436 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 34 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 385863 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * lo.lo_discount) AS discounted_sales, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 74 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 37 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8381590 AND COUNT(*) > 480 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year, dd.d_month) AS running_revenue_by_segment_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 25 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Winter') AND p.p_size >= 1 AND p.p_size <= 3 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7350233 AND COUNT(*) >= 951 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, dd.d_month LIMIT 1956;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19966268 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND p.p_size > 20 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 541598 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS shipmodes_used, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS colors_ordered, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size >= 27 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8745763 AND COUNT(*) >= 293 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 25 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.94 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19958825 AND 19928519) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' ORDER BY l2.lo_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 31 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 962896 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3296411 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM ( SELECT lo_partkey, MAX(lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY lo_partkey ) sub ) AS max_part_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 50 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 374319 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 57;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 119088 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 2 AND p.p_size <= 7 AND l.lo_discount >= 0 AND l.lo_discount <= 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 858208 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 41 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 190941 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19953167 AND 19956837) AS max_extended_price_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND l.lo_quantity > 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 41 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 69901674 AND COUNT(*) >= 756 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 852;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(lo.lo_tax) AS max_tax, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 16.53 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.03 AND 18.45 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997.78 AND 1993.77 AND p.p_size >= 21.98 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s2.s_region = s.s_region AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue * 0.5 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo3.lo_orderdate = lo.lo_orderdate AND lo3.lo_suppkey <> lo.lo_suppkey AND lo3.lo_ordertotalprice > lo.lo_ordertotalprice ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 39980.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 54.26 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 7662.64;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 25 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 36 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5197281 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 32 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 785;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 563121 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 23 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 42 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 345388 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 397;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19975511 AND 19975881 AND d.d_year IN (1995, 1996, 1997) AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 7 AND l.lo_quantity > 13 AND p.p_size > 41 AND (d.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 OR d.d_lastdayinmonthfl = 1) AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) - d.d_year) = 0 AND TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '1990-01-01' + INTERVAL '42 days' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9067202 AND COUNT(*) >= 289 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 7479;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_pair FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19951006 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19962281 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND p.p_size > 8 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, dd.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5829454 AND COUNT(*) >= 11 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, supplier_nation LIMIT 4041;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND dd.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 69132 AND COUNT(*) >= 57 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4559 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 48 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 37 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 531725 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) > 640 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS all_shipmodes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS all_colors, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 22.19 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.76 AND 3.78 AND d.d_year >= 1993.19 AND p.p_size >= 31.12 AND c.c_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CHINA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 681657.39 AND COUNT(*) > 786.87 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1862.9;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 27 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 4 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 13773 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 43 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND (d.d_holidayfl = 1 OR d.d_weekdayfl = 1) AND lo.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate + 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 234719 AND COUNT(*) > 746 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1992 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 635372 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_discount >= 7 THEN lo.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN lo.lo_quantity > 48 THEN 1 END) AS high_quantity_orders, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 984241 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( lo.lo_quantity > 42.01 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.65 AND 4.84 AND d.d_year >= 1997.25 ) OR ( lo.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19944360.41 AND 19975132.05) AND p.p_size IN (SELECT p2.p_size FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_category = p.p_category GROUP BY p2.p_size HAVING COUNT(*) > 22.15) ) OR ( s.s_region = (SELECT s2.s_region FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nation = s.s_nation LIMIT 1) AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_datekey = lo.lo_commitdate AND d2.d_holidayfl = 1 AND d2.d_year = d.d_year) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 253021.9 AND COUNT(*) > 24.17 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 8294.81;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub_lo.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder sub_lo WHERE sub_lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub_lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19942592 AND 19960919) AS max_order_total_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount >= 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 28 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 331167 AND COUNT(*) > 40 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 205;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(lo.lo_supplycost), 0)) AS revenue_to_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 6 AND lo.lo_quantity > 10 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 0.61 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19933766 AND 19973280) AND COUNT(*) > 930 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_in_segment_category LIMIT 832;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 33 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 34 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'FRANCE', 'JAPAN') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9400238 AND COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 285708.54 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 58.78 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.33 AND 8.22 AND dd.d_year >= 2003.01 AND p.p_size > 20.59 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CHINA', 'GERMANY') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 298350.69 AND COUNT(*) > 805.77 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MAX(lo.lo_quantity) AS max_line_quantity, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 38 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 13 AND d.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size > 20 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1228149 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 29 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_mktsegment ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 44 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1996 AND p.p_size > 39 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5160657 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 81 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_mktsegment ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 34 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND d2.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND l2.lo_revenue > 912983 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN supplier s3 ON l3.lo_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s3.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l3.lo_quantity < 84 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2479372 AND COUNT(*) >= 423 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brand_list, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 39509.87 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 427941.21 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 5 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND lo.lo_revenue > 226548 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 11 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 477130 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 74 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 6574;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_size > 18 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 21043 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 33 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 178 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 601795 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue_per_order, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 970656 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 288347 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_national_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 60 AND dd.d_year >= 2007 AND p.p_size > 13 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8826632 AND COUNT(*) >= 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, dd.d_year LIMIT 62;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 57871 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 26 AND 39 AND lo.lo_discount >= 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 34 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND (lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' OR lo.lo_shipmode = 'TRUCK') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = lo.lo_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 33044 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 21195 AND COUNT(*) > 27 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3179;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p90_extendedprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 618618.16 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 35.09 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.3 AND 3.5 AND d.d_year >= 1992.81 AND p.p_size > 18.58 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 447929.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 30.36 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19927407 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19925974 AND p.p_size >= 14 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 96718313 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 702 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19944584 AND 19967470) AS avg_supplycost_for_part_supplier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19934417 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19976530 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND p.p_size > 26 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_partkey, l.lo_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6438502 AND COUNT(*) >= 49 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.37 AND 13.63 AND l.lo_quantity > 12.66 AND d.d_year >= 1994.0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND d2.d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason AND l2.lo_revenue > 57218.74 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l3.lo_orderpriority = '5-LOW' AND l3.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 258088.79 AND COUNT(*) > 48.34 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19963779 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 734011) AND l.lo_quantity > 35 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 27 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 47491810 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 8515;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND p.p_size >= 43 AND p.p_size <= 47 AND l.lo_discount >= 2 AND l.lo_discount <= 0 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8108566 AND COUNT(*) >= 692 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_datekey RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 32836.29 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 58.76 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.54 AND 7.56 AND d.d_year >= 1997.47 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer') AND p.p_size > 37.45 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 298439.31 AND COUNT(*) >= 807.53 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, supplier_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extended_price, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS percentile_75_supply_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_line_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 9431 AND lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19932954 AND 19931930 AND p.p_size >= 48 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_quantity) > 883 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) < 17316 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1995 AND d2.d_year <= 1993 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND l.lo_quantity > 48 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 AND p.p_size >= 24 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9031263 AND COUNT(*) >= 981 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 874;
