SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 29 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 181356 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3863 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 173722.13 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 83.77 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.54 AND 7.74 AND d.d_year >= 1992.1 AND p.p_size > 49.09 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_holidayfl = 0.12 GROUP BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 416362.11 AND COUNT(*) > 647.03 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND d.d_year = 1993 AND p.p_partkey IN ( SELECT p2.p_partkey FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 11 ) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3731275 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 OR l.lo_tax > 7) AND NOT (p.p_size < 50 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4524333 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, MAX(lo.lo_tax) AS max_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 3087326.61 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 98.64 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.94 AND 12.64 AND d.d_year >= 2004.9 AND p.p_size > 47.5 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1672013.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) > 269.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 15 AND l.lo_quantity > 68 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 7 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 16782522 AND COUNT(*) >= 2146 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 24 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 734525 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.42 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19977362) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 99258959 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 8 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 291361 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 12 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_discount >= 6 THEN lo.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN 1 END) AS urgent_order_count, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19938483 AND 19954318 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 23444 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 694824.72 AND d.d_year >= 1996.82 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 35.76 AND 25.8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 176438.64 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(lo.lo_orderpriority) AS min_order_priority, MAX(lo.lo_shipmode) AS max_ship_mode, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity_for_brand FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_extendedprice > 44868.72 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 14.99 AND 43.28 AND d.d_year >= 1996.31 AND (c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING') AND p.p_brand1 SIMILAR TO 'Brand%1' AND s.s_region ~ 'AMERICA' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode LIKE 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate > 19935110.35) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 767278.4 AND COUNT(*) > 47.27 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4.54 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = lo.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_for_combo FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 8 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 33 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, lo.lo_orderdate, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8124597 AND COUNT(*) > 134 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_profit DESC LIMIT 805;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 2 AND p.p_size > 22 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 212481 AND COUNT(*) >= 19 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) / NULLIF(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND lo.lo_quantity > 100 AND dd.d_year >= 2002 AND p.p_size > 7 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.35 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_suppkey IN (SELECT s2.s_suppkey FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = s.s_region)) AND COUNT(*) > 401 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 2511;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND s.s_nation LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 41.26 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.45 AND 9.04 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995.05 AND 1996.66 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6051022.35 AND COUNT(*) >= 893.8 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19930993 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19960238 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND p.p_size > 28 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9106535 AND COUNT(*) >= 672 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 15 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 20 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 35822528 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 332733.8 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 5.0 AND p.p_size <= 10.61 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.85 AND 9.13 AND d.d_year >= 1994.81 AND d.d_year <= 1995.97 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1980277.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 18.87 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 6209.67;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 763140.32 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 38.28 AND p.p_size <= 4.62 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.76 AND 3.71 AND c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_year >= 1995.36 AND d.d_year <= 1997.02 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 467408.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 51.95 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, p.p_category LIMIT 500.92;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 49 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 231059 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount >= 9 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 31 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4098680 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, s.s_region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 14 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND l.lo_revenue > 273663 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 37 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, s.s_region), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, s.s_region), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 360009 AND COUNT(*) >= 545 ORDER BY c.c_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 9775826.22 AND l.lo_quantity >= 40.5 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.6 AND 3.94 AND d.d_year >= 1992.56 AND d.d_year <= 1996.17 AND p.p_size > 42.93 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (s.s_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 40773904.2 AND COUNT(*) >= 409.31 ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_nation LIKE 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 34328276 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT (l.lo_orderkey, l.lo_linenumber)) AS distinct_order_lines, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 17.62 AND d.d_year >= 1994.16 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 3.28 AND 35.5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 992844.53 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE 'AIR' AND p.p_type LIKE 'ECONOMY' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AFRICA' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND lo.lo_quantity > 2.78 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.36 AND 9.78 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1995.53 AND 1993.74 AND lo.lo_revenue > 181673.25 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 86484.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 24.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 47 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2017 AND 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 128982 AND COUNT(*) >= 611 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 24.43 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.31 AND 6.71 AND dd.d_year >= 1996.08 AND p.p_size >= 41.56 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND dd2.d_sellingseason = dd.d_sellingseason AND lo2.lo_revenue > 26407.27 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo3.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo3.lo_orderpriority = '5-LOW' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 935939.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 63.71 ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, revenue_rank_in_segment_category, dd.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS prev_revenue_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 650950.07 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 12.92 AND p.p_size <= 17.68 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.72 AND 6.35 AND d.d_year >= 1993.52 AND d.d_year <= 1994.61 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 299516.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 43.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 9070.85;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.59 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19933169 AND 19964455) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1996 AND p.p_size >= 45 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND d2.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND l2.lo_revenue > 170038 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN supplier s3 ON l3.lo_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s3.s_nation = s.s_nation AND l3.lo_quantity < 100 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9714583 AND COUNT(*) > 22 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 3047;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS shipmodes_used, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS colors_ordered, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 29 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size >= 7 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3429346 AND COUNT(*) >= 745 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 4483;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 11 AND 67 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1998 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 17 AND lo.lo_quantity > 48 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 199643 AND d_ship.d_holidayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1055390 AND COUNT(*) >= 932 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 14 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, d.d_year LIMIT 8909;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 620 ORDER BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 25 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size >= 17 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7997499 AND COUNT(*) >= 469 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_nation_year_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19979429 AND p.p_size > 9 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 897851 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 25 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19928228 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19971724 AND p.p_size > 44 AND p.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_holidayfl = 1 AND d.d_weekdayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 76119561 AND COUNT(*) >= 470 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 5.78 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.67 AND 6.63 AND d.d_year >= 1996.46 AND p.p_size > 42.64 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN part p2 ON l2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19960539.99 AND 19942537.75 AND p2.p_color = 'RED' AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue * 0.5 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN supplier s3 ON l3.lo_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s3.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l3.lo_orderdate < 19948564.75 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 18036949.18 AND COUNT(*) > 740.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_pair FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19929375 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19949145 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND p.p_size > 24 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, dd.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3812785 AND COUNT(*) >= 613 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, supplier_nation LIMIT 1382;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_quantity) DESC) AS quantity_rank_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 9913686.5 AND l.lo_quantity >= 68.78 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.57 AND 4.84 AND dd.d_year >= 1994.18 AND p.p_size > 10.43 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1285733.16 AND COUNT(*) >= 464.8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 41 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 80972 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 91 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 43 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3010290 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 48 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 281752 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19921449 AND 19920641) AS max_customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2319957 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4510 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1946144 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_region, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_extendedprice) AS avg_extendedprice, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY s.s_region, p.p_brand1 HAVING AVG(l.lo_extendedprice) < 175306 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND l.lo_discount <= 9 AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 26005475 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 5003 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1794192 UNION ALL SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_shippriority = 3 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 41 ORDER BY d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS low_disc_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount > 5 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_disc_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_quantity > 25 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3367688 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND l.lo_quantity > 93 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 10 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 31372730 AND COUNT(*) >= 8713 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19981066) AS max_extended_price_for_part FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_supplycost) > 27432 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 43 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 85839231 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 569243.32 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19941635 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 15 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 318255 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 36 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 165836 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1994 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 515050 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3338741 AND AVG(l.lo_quantity) >= 44 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND p.p_brand1 = 'MFGR#1111' AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) > 41 AND SUM(l.lo_supplycost) < 70246 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 19.35 AND dd.d_year = 1995.52 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 448787.52 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_extendedprice > 42633.39 AND dd.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2.14 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_region_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 16 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 59809814 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 619942.02 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 23.34 AND 31.75 AND lo.lo_discount >= 6.87 AND p.p_size > 21.26 AND dd.d_year >= 1993.43 AND dd.d_year <= 1997.64 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'BUILDING', 'FURNITURE') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND (lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 352880.86 HAVING COUNT(*) > 4.38 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 269225.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 7.68 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7.67 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 975.33;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_sellingseason, p.p_category ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 37.12 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.1 AND 0.68 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1995.46 AND 1993.65 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 45346521.09 AND COUNT(*) >= 894.53 ORDER BY dd.d_year DESC, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shippriority = 1 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 767686) AND lo.lo_commitdate <= lo.lo_orderdate + 120 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 2 AND 24 AND dd.d_year >= 2005 AND lo.lo_discount > (SELECT AVG(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19963422 AND lo_orderdate <= 19962708) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 19315198 AND COUNT(*) > 540 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_profit DESC LIMIT 234;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_per_combo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 9960088.65 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 13.16 AND 6.42 AND d.d_year IN (1995.72, 1996.5, 1995.76) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_orderdate, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4131177.86 AND COUNT(*) > 453.36 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_in_segment_nation ASC LIMIT 1206.58;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19952330 AND p.p_size > 12 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3351879 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 722027 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9988794 AND COUNT(*) >= 93 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND lo.lo_quantity > 73 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND p.p_size >= 6 AND p.p_color = 'almond' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1993 AND dd.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR') AND (lo.lo_extendedprice * lo.lo_quantity) > 834373 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8236548 AND COUNT(*) >= 720 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, dd.d_year LIMIT 107;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 2 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 158694 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19926741 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19972336 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND p.p_size > 25 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1106868 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 20 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 24943 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1997 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 4 AND 49 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 857297 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 784588.95 AND l.lo_quantity >= 62.96 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.46 AND 5.65 AND d.d_year >= 1990.46 AND p.p_size > 25.68 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 292299.68 AND COUNT(*) >= 574.12 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue_nation_category_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 47 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 27622 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_season_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year >= 1998 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring') AND l.lo_orderdate <= (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year <= 1995 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 20 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19966079 AND l2.lo_revenue > 96591 GROUP BY l2.lo_custkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.lo_partkey) > 70 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 336691 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 752;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19935181) AS recent_order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19961663 AND 19946540 AND l.lo_discount >= 5 AND p.p_size >= 32 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 588857 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON l.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = d.d_year AND d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1992 AND p.p_size >= 41 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 2 AND d_commit.d_holidayfl = 0 AND d_ship.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN d.d_datekey - 365 AND d.d_datekey) > 46 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3203812 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 884824.57 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 24.25 AND p.p_size <= 36.78 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.84 AND 5.57 AND c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_year >= 1995.08 AND d.d_year <= 1992.2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 12509.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 94.97 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, p.p_category LIMIT 504.03;
