SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate >= 19952992 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 6060) AND p.p_size BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND lo.lo_discount > 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8710139 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 518;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7450598 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 77 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3189456 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 34 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 772597 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_qty FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 50150.56 AND l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19958218 AND 19936300 AND p.p_size > 24.61 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.77 AND 3.71 AND (c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING') AND p.p_category ~ 'MFGR#1' AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Summer') AND l.lo_shipmode NOT LIKE 'TRUCK' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 318261.61 AND COUNT(*) > 223.37 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 16.11 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 677.53;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 35 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 30 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2907462 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 72 AND (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) > 2525656 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 32 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND dd.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 16 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 51571642 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo INNER JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 19 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 1 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 57127013 AND COUNT(*) > 983 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 4851;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS shipmodes_used, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS colors_ordered, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 49 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 29 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7930470 AND COUNT(*) >= 656 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12month_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 23 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 458107 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, d.d_month DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 23 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 25 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 74325265 AND COUNT(*) > 133 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 20 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 443879.49 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 12.24 AND 57.22 AND d.d_year >= 1997.05 AND p.p_size > 5.63 AND lo.lo_discount < 8.04 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region), (s.s_region), (p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2785538.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 669.86 ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS LAST, s.s_region NULLS LAST, p.p_category NULLS LAST, d.d_year NULLS LAST, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8764826 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_region, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_extendedprice) AS avg_extendedprice, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY s.s_region, p.p_brand1 HAVING AVG(l.lo_extendedprice) < 187651 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgent_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_orders, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9455446 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 5760 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 14 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3987 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5102601 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_suppkey IN ( SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_region = 'AMERICA' ) AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 18861383 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey WHERE l2.lo_discount < 9.83 GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extendedprice FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995.91 AND d.d_year <= 1995.91 AND l.lo_quantity > 9.57 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6737663.84 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.75 AND 5.08 AND l.lo_orderpriority LIKE '1-URGENT' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1993.05 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1598653.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 461.17 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, total_revenue DESC, order_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 33 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8682031 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY p.p_category) AS running_revenue_by_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_commitdate IN (SELECT lo_commitdate FROM lineorder WHERE lo_supplycost > 7106 GROUP BY lo_commitdate HAVING COUNT(*) > 48)) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 65373744 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) AS prev_period_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 254995.37 AND l.lo_quantity >= 23.3 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.59 AND 12.05 AND d.d_year >= 1992.62 AND d.d_year <= 1998.46 AND p.p_size > 35.68 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2561123.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 157.06 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 156994.58 AND d.d_year >= 1993.33 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 40.54 AND 23.06 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 15024.07 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 580303.45 AND lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19928407.02 AND 19920103.55 AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.45 AND 8.99 AND p.p_size IN (SELECT p2.p_size FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_color LIKE 'almond' GROUP BY p2.p_size HAVING COUNT(*) > 5.86) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 21209.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 55.15 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7056.58;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( l.lo_revenue > 506553.51 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.97 AND 18.97 ) OR ( l.lo_quantity > 60.93 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN '19920101' AND '19920101' AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue * 1.28 ) ) OR ( p.p_size > 36.09 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = s.s_region AND s2.s_nation <> s.s_nation AND s2.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT l3.lo_suppkey FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l3.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' ) ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 145142.41 AND COUNT(*) >= 20.25 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 851.09;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 59807 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 39 AND 31 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 29850 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_discount >= 8 THEN lo.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN lo.lo_quantity > 19 THEN 1 END) AS high_quantity_orders, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1994 AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 729367 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 38291963.58 AND lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19949169.8 AND 19966354.2 AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'Brand#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE 'Spring' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND dd2.d_year = dd.d_year - 1 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 32954123.43 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_quantity) > 39912.01 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7509.66;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR l.lo_orderpriority = '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_quantity > 20.48 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.52 AND 5.81 AND d.d_year >= 1993.17 AND (l.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19972812.4 AND 19933987.3) OR l.lo_supplycost < (SELECT MIN(lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19962229.5 AND 19973356.95)) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3546819.65 AND COUNT(*) > 215.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19928690 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= 19956291) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 764594 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND l.lo_discount <= 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3757252 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l2.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l1 ON c.c_custkey = l1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l1.lo_orderdate = l2.lo_orderdate JOIN dim_date d ON l1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l1.lo_revenue > 40648.92 AND d.d_year >= 1995.47 AND p.p_size > 49.09 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l1.lo_revenue) > 433224.31 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 814945 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19925268 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 340988 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MIN(lo.lo_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS last_order_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_category_time FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND lo.lo_quantity > 34.91 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 8278.3 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.67 AND 3.63 AND d.d_year >= 1993.12 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND d.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 6.91 AND 3.82 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 37.86 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 986983.98 AND COUNT(*) > 46.6 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 8.53 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 24 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 944 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 724637 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_national_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 62 AND dd.d_year >= 2004 AND p.p_size > 27 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1460293 AND COUNT(*) >= 62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, dd.d_year LIMIT 850;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS p90_ordertotalprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 980834 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 35 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 23 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 376429 AND COUNT(*) > 784 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;
