SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 12 AND l.lo_quantity > 41 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 3 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 793074 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, c.c_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, c.c_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3158 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 41998.88 AND d.d_year >= 1993.79 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 37.89 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 11 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 61266 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 922534 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 969493.84 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 48.88 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.29 AND 1.98 AND d.d_year >= 1996.66 AND d.d_year <= 1992.41 AND p.p_size > 30.51 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 414688.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 61.34 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR l.lo_orderpriority = '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_quantity > 5.81 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.12 AND 6.67 AND d.d_year >= 1994.7 AND (l.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19960677.83 AND 19969714.81) OR l.lo_supplycost < (SELECT MIN(lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19964613.42 AND 19927941.88)) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6572057.73 AND COUNT(*) > 560.66 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 844070 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_brand1 = 'MFGR#1121' AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l.lo_quantity > 50 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING AVG(l.lo_extendedprice) < 158627 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 591593 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 19 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_last_30_days, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_last_30_days, COUNT(*) AS order_count_last_30_days FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_date >= '1992-01-01' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.25 AND 8.88 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 78833.34 ORDER BY total_revenue_last_30_days DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_extended_price) FROM (SELECT lo2.lo_partkey, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_extended_price FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19971604 AND lo2.lo_orderdate <= 19942041 GROUP BY lo2.lo_partkey) sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = lo.lo_partkey) AS max_part_extended_price_in_period, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 48 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 25 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, lo.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5646079 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 32 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 735;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_discount) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19961433 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19930560) AS avg_customer_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 48759 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 36 AND 20 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 15 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(inner_sub.lo_revenue) * 1.25 FROM lineorder inner_sub JOIN dim_date inner_d ON inner_sub.lo_orderdate = inner_d.d_datekey WHERE inner_d.d_year = d.d_year AND inner_d.d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason) AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 16 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_nation_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 357595 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 13 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 34 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 90330 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 49 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 757;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 34 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 39145 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue ORDER BY l2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 34 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 855598 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS running_nation_category_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS region_season_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19931002 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19974273 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND p.p_size >= 27 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4694338 AND COUNT(*) >= 762 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.lo_shipmode, ', ' ORDER BY l.lo_shipmode) AS aggregated_shipmodes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 29689.82 AND l.lo_quantity >= 27.59 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.66 AND 1990.59 AND p.p_size > 44.9 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 262807.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 69.54 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 741.34;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND lo.lo_discount >= 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 634012 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN lo.lo_discount >= 8 THEN lo.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN lo.lo_quantity > 48 THEN 1 END) AS high_quantity_orders, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 135932 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 619090 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 2 AND l.lo_quantity > 42 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1997 AND p.p_size > 38 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 95246631 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 41 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND l.lo_quantity > 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6334229 AND COUNT(*) >= 475 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.4 AND 3.91 AND lo.lo_quantity > 47.2 AND dd.d_year >= 1997.11 AND p.p_size > 12.98 AND (c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES' OR s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 68236897.88 AND COUNT(*) > 95.86 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4.76 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4188796 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 22 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 27 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 399415 AND COUNT(*) >= 743 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12month_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19973793 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 18815 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, d.d_month DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8351 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 9164 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_rev) FROM (SELECT d2.d_year, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS max_rev FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE d2.d_year = d.d_year GROUP BY d2.d_year) sub) AS max_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 10 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4048301 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount > 7 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 27 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5521297 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 24 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 965875 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey, c1.c_name, c1.c_city, c2.c_custkey AS related_custkey, c2.c_name AS related_name, c2.c_city AS related_city, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN customer c2 ON c1.c_city = c2.c_city AND c1.c_custkey <> c2.c_custkey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON c2.c_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE dd1.d_year = 1995 AND dd2.d_year = 1994 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 38 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 38 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c1.c_name, c1.c_city, c2.c_custkey, c2.c_name, c2.c_city HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 646818 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 558726 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_region_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND l.lo_quantity > 37 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size >= 48 AND s.s_nation IN ('ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2501433 AND COUNT(*) >= 539 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size >= 7 AND p.p_size <= 26 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND dd.d_year <= 1993 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 42473742 AND COUNT(*) >= 65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 9848;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1994 AND d2.d_year <= 1991 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' ) AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 16 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'UNITED STATES', 'UNITED STATES') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2914793 AND COUNT(*) >= 288 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 8982;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1996 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 507589 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19972850 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19937233 AND ( l.lo_discount > 0 OR l.lo_quantity < 15 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_revenue > 285770 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l3.lo_orderpriority = 'URGENT' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 477034 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_quantity) AS high_quantity_percentile, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 217627 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9267553 AND COUNT(*) >= 15 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 31 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 0 AND lo.lo_quantity > 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9342969 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 47 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 20 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 882731 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (lo.lo_orderdate + 30) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 13 AND 28 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1996 AND d_commit.d_year = d.d_year AND d_ship.d_holidayfl = 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4310401 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 902 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 658189 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 47 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS LAST, c.c_nation NULLS LAST, p.p_category NULLS LAST, p.p_brand1 NULLS LAST, d.d_year NULLS LAST, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON p2.p_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5563169 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19947827) AS max_extended_price_for_part FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_supplycost) > 23115 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 651735 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 24 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 31126 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR', 'FOB', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 18 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND ( c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR (dd.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT') ) AND lo.lo_commitdate <= lo.lo_orderdate + 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 908116 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 33 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 39 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19947030 AND 19923348 AND lo2.lo_discount > 4) AND COUNT(*) > 579 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 3553;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, MAX(lo.lo_quantity) AS max_line_quantity, MIN(lo.lo_discount) AS min_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 45 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 12 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 2 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3908864 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 100 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC, c.c_mktsegment ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.lo_orderkey::text, '-', l.lo_linenumber::text)) AS distinct_line_items, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 155942.39 AND l.lo_quantity >= 55.2 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.28 AND 9.93 AND d.d_year >= 1994.78 AND p.p_size > 5.64 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 464516.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 358.78 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brands_purchased, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 83395.44 AND d.d_year >= 1992.08 AND d.d_year <= 1996.21 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 592.73 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19921367 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= 19945528) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 643000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1997 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 293482 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_quantity > 40 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING AVG(l.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 756094 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 47 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 18 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 318935 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 43 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 874;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 5.34 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.92 AND 8.54 AND d.d_year >= 1994.59 AND p.p_size > 14.21 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 637494.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 18.86 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 791605.21 AND l.lo_quantity >= 89.98 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.94 AND 8.47 AND d.d_year >= 1994.23 AND d.d_year <= 1997.32 AND p.p_size > 1.48 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'MIDDLE EAST') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 454215.13 AND COUNT(*) >= 271.84 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1084.89;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_size > 25 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 690726 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7106003 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3893323 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON p2.p_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = d.d_year) GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price_in_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1056484 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_revenue > 103936.9 OR l.lo_revenue IS NULL) AND (d.d_year >= 1993.97 OR d.d_year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 57.68 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (l.lo_orderdate IS NULL OR d.d_year >= 1995.53) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 29.82 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 798860 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 470355 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 19979469 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19926727 AND p.p_size > 1 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4282064 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 25.87 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.06 AND 5.54 AND d.d_year >= 1992.07 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 646395.8 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_partkey IN ( SELECT p2.p_partkey FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 1 ) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2488394 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_discount_for_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount > 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 8 AND 30 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8173481 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 48 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4752122 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.58 AND 1.98 AND d.d_year >= 1993.85 AND p.p_size > 15.56 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8369968.13 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1993 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 488719 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND l.lo_quantity > 26 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 24 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 201778 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo INNER JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19951456 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19955548 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND p.p_size > 42 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3305514 AND COUNT(*) >= 80 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 9556;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year = 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 907873 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8640 ORDER BY c.c_nation, revenue_rank_in_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 23.57 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.92 AND 7.63 AND d.d_year >= 1995.87 AND p.p_size > 15.94 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 39061.02 ) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 298272.1 AND COUNT(*) > 2.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region LIMIT 8842.87;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_weeknuminyear, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, MIN(lo.lo_commitdate) AS earliest_commit_date, MAX(lo.lo_orderdate) AS latest_order_date, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month) AS prev_month_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 44 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 10734 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND d.d_monthnuminyear BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 42 AND 23 AND p.p_color IN ('almond', 'almond', 'almond') AND s.s_region IN ('AFRICA', 'AFRICA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_weeknuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 28986 AND COUNT(*) > 95 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, revenue_rank_in_region_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 14 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 635 ORDER BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND s.s_nation LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 11.03 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.11 AND 5.57 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995.95 AND 1992.9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8778870.05 AND COUNT(*) >= 23.53 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 3731925 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 22 AND 85 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer') AND s.s_region = 'ASIA' AND p.p_size > 18 AND lo.lo_discount < 8 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum > d.d_yearmonthnum AND d_ship.d_holidayfl = 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2476786 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 82 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3794;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 25 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND p.p_size >= 44 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 189809 AND COUNT(*) >= 590 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 18 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5755866 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 20 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 70300817 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 36 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 861944 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brand_list FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.99 AND 5.35 AND d.d_year >= 1994.04 AND p.p_size > 41.67 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 643039.58 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS segment_year_running_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 37 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_size > 34 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 865161 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, d.d_year;
