SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 18 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2006 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 546639 AND COUNT(*) >= 779 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19933238 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19927663 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND p.p_size > 18 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2680935 AND COUNT(*) >= 471 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 4066;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 631108.69 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 10.16 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.49 AND 6.38 AND dd.d_year >= 2006.13 AND dd.d_year <= 2008.93 AND p.p_size > 5.52 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 343963.17 AND COUNT(*) >= 524.61 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_per_combo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 7736268.66 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 4.5 AND 9.77 AND d.d_year IN (1992.26, 1996.21, 1995.6) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_orderdate, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 737084.82 AND COUNT(*) > 896.58 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_in_segment_nation ASC LIMIT 3679.46;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19963960 ) AS avg_extended_price_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 85439 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.37 AND 2.73 AND d.d_year = 1995.43 AND (p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' )) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 277734.21 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19921698 AND 19968525) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 689226 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 14 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 6 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_suppkey IN (SELECT s2.s_suppkey FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_region = s.s_region)) AND COUNT(*) > 734 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey, AVG(lo_inner.lo_quantity) AS avg_qty_per_part FROM lineorder lo_inner WHERE lo_inner.lo_orderdate >= 19976729 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey ) AS sub ON c.c_custkey = sub.lo_custkey AND p.p_partkey = sub.lo_partkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19943895 AND 19958362 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 2 AND p.p_size > 10 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES') AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND (sub.avg_qty_per_part IS NULL OR lo.lo_quantity > sub.avg_qty_per_part * 2.53) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2651913 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 26 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1498;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND p.p_size >= 14 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 4 AND s.s_region != 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19980038 AND 19929347) AND COUNT(*) > 502 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CASE WHEN SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 53014096.96 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN SUM(lo.lo_revenue) BETWEEN 157284.1 AND 493736.2 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE' ELSE 'LOW_VALUE' END AS revenue_segment, CASE WHEN d.d_holidayfl = 1 THEN 'HOLIDAY' WHEN d.d_weekdayfl = 1 THEN 'WEEKDAY' ELSE 'WEEKEND' END AS date_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear) AS running_revenue_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity >= 98.51 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.33 AND 0.85 AND d.d_year >= 1996.37 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 3.15 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_holidayfl, d.d_weekdayfl, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 49622.63 AND COUNT(*) >= 444.57 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'AIR', 'SHIP') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1993 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND p.p_size >= 44 AND lo.lo_custkey IN ( SELECT lo2.lo_custkey FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE d2.d_year = 1992 GROUP BY lo2.lo_custkey HAVING SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) > 3554180 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4064900 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 859;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 93 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 50 AND c.c_nation IN ('ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 55708437 AND COUNT(*) > 266 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 270;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1992 AND lo.lo_quantity > 38 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND p.p_size >= 26 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6395849 AND COUNT(*) >= 286 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 31.29 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.84 AND 5.64 AND d.d_year >= 1993.37 AND d.d_year <= 1995.11 AND p.p_size > 20.01 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 828254.54 AND COUNT(*) > 250.19 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 43 AND (c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2083802 AND COUNT(*) >= 104 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_pair, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 19 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1998 AND p.p_size >= 21 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 43328980 AND COUNT(*) > 244 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, total_revenue DESC, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.29 AND 6.19 AND d.d_year = 1994.07 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM part p WHERE p.p_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 219958.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 7 AND dd.d_year = 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8752299 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue_4period, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 46 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999 AND p.p_size > 22 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5018242 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 6114 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_in_region_season ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND lo.lo_quantity > 13 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 95534 AND COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 1920 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19977932 AND 19947619) AS max_extended_price_for_part FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, p.p_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4174365 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2773739 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7001353 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.11 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19926805) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year) AS running_revenue_by_segment_nation FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 33 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 145803 AND COUNT(*) >= 85 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, s.s_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 299097 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND p.p_brand1 = 'MFGR#1111' AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_supplycost) < 129 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo.lo_tax) AS total_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND d.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 23.09 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.23 AND 9.54 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994.47 AND 1993.73 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d2.d_datekey) FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1997.8 AND d2.d_month LIKE '%') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 713645898.9 AND COUNT(*) >= 985.65 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 4245.01;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_region_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND l.lo_quantity > 44 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size >= 16 AND s.s_nation IN ('ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 803187 AND COUNT(*) >= 721 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year, dd.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 27 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 4 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6361458 AND COUNT(*) > 957 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * lo.lo_discount) AS discounted_sales, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(lo.lo_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND lo.lo_quantity > 45 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 13 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_shipmode = 'AIR') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5704545 AND COUNT(*) > 800 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l.lo_orderdate = l2.lo_orderdate WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.39 AND 2.77 AND d.d_year >= 1998.41 AND p.p_size > 3.25 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 430326.39 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19953524) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 455854 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19942578) AS avg_customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 639514 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.35 AND 5.51 AND d.d_year = 1992.02 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s JOIN lineorder l2 ON s.s_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey WHERE s.s_nation = c.c_nation AND l2.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 303770.12 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE (l.lo_discount > 9.99 AND l.lo_quantity < 47.56) OR (l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1995.22 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' )) OR (p.p_size > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_size) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_category = p.p_category )) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 744245.19 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 34.68;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l2.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l1 ON c.c_custkey = l1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_custkey = l2.lo_custkey AND l1.lo_orderdate = l2.lo_orderdate JOIN dim_date d ON l1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l1.lo_revenue > 89935.99 AND d.d_year >= 1997.51 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l1.lo_revenue) > 19515.09 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_color LIKE 'blue' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1995.45 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.81 AND 6.43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 463163.39 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 689694.47 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 92.44 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.85 AND 5.09 AND d.d_year >= 1990.41 AND p.p_size > 7.95 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 322086.07 AND COUNT(*) > 2.96 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10) OR (lo.lo_tax > 1 AND lo.lo_shippriority = 2) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 1 OR p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK')) AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_region = 'AFRICA') AND (s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_region = 'AFRICA') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1993 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode NOT IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1964168 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 92 AND AVG(lo.lo_quantity) < 69 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19963680 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19966002 AND lo.lo_discount >= 4 AND lo.lo_discount <= 10 AND p.p_size >= 48 AND p.p_size <= 12 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, d.d_datekey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1321764 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, d.d_year, d.d_month LIMIT 5805;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_customer_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey LEFT JOIN dim_date d_commit ON l.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey LEFT JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = d.d_year AND d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 30 AND 37 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19930560 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19934327 AND (l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 OR l.lo_tax > 8) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue * 0.5) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1094168 AND COUNT(*) > 904 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 17 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '|' || lo.lo_linenumber) AS distinct_order_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19928955 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19934918 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND p.p_size >= 25 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 24647668 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey || '|' || lo.lo_linenumber) >= 542954 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1997 AND p.p_size > 37 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 13 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7737749 AND COUNT(*) >= 465 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19925217 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19937907 AND ( l.lo_discount > 4 OR l.lo_quantity < 13 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_revenue > 926080 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l3.lo_orderpriority = 'URGENT' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 372686 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CASE WHEN SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 66725106.36 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN SUM(lo.lo_revenue) BETWEEN 290020.73 AND 557998.53 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE' ELSE 'LOW_VALUE' END AS revenue_segment, CASE WHEN d.d_holidayfl = 1 THEN 'HOLIDAY' WHEN d.d_weekdayfl = 1 THEN 'WEEKDAY' ELSE 'WEEKEND' END AS date_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear) AS running_revenue_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity >= 23.45 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.29 AND 7.0 AND d.d_year >= 1992.86 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 43.17 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_holidayfl, d.d_weekdayfl, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 30388.17 AND COUNT(*) >= 131.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 846233 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT DISTINCT lo_inner.lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder lo_inner WHERE lo_inner.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo_inner.lo_commitdate >= 19976864) AND p.p_size BETWEEN 15 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND lo.lo_discount > 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 24097745 AND COUNT(*) >= 655 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 2 AND d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_size > 28 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 334504 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 303525 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5745791 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 40 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 36150734 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1997 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3700 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 343760 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_region AS cust1_region, c2.c_region AS cust2_region, d.d_year AS order_year, d.d_sellingseason AS selling_season, p.p_category AS part_category, s.s_region AS supplier_region, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS cust1_total_revenue, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS cust2_total_revenue, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(lo2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity_cust2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_suppkey = lo2.lo_suppkey AND lo1.lo_orderdate = lo2.lo_orderdate AND lo1.lo_custkey < lo2.lo_custkey JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE lo1.lo_revenue > 482657.12 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 541401.9 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.73 AND 1993.43 AND p.p_size >= 7.03 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_region, c2.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 75.73 AND SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) > SUM(lo2.lo_quantity) ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, cust1_total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_type LIKE 'ECONOMY' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995.58 AND 1997.98 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_city, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 453717.39 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 41 AND 8 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 0 AND lo.lo_quantity > 1 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1993 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_region = 'EUROPE') AND (p.p_category = 'MFGR#1' OR p.p_category = 'MFGR#2') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9377953 AND COUNT(*) >= 153 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 33.04 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.19 AND 5.5 AND dd.d_year >= 1993.66 AND p.p_size >= 19.06 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND dd2.d_sellingseason = dd.d_sellingseason AND lo2.lo_revenue > 7822.74 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo3.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo3.lo_orderpriority = '5-LOW' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 703171.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 45.55 ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, revenue_rank_in_segment_category, dd.d_year, s.s_region LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ( SELECT MAX(l2.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19975257 AND 19943157 ) AS max_order_total_for_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR') AND p.p_size >= 42 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND l.lo_quantity > 22 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8430686 AND COUNT(*) >= 396 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_rolling_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS brand_revenue_rank_in_category_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 6 AND lo.lo_quantity > 20 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 26 AND 12 AND (d.d_weeknuminyear = 5 OR d.d_monthnuminyear = 1) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5111778 AND COUNT(*) >= 512 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, nation_year_rolling_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 50884920 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19921524 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 36.06 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 25966.61 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.27 AND 6.0 AND dd.d_year >= 1996.23 AND dd.d_year <= 1995.35 AND p.p_size > 8.38 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 12936.81 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 818357.21 AND COUNT(*) > 61.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_category LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND s.s_region LIKE 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1996.84 AND d.d_year <= 1992.04 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 746359.61 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( (l.lo_quantity > 45 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 4) OR (l.lo_extendedprice > 26631 AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK', 'SHIP')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 44 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'CANADA', 'BRAZIL')) AND c.c_mktsegment NOT IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'MACHINERY') AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND (l.lo_tax > 43 OR l.lo_commitdate < l.lo_orderdate + 310) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 461148 AND COUNT(*) >= 49 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 11 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 3 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 305355 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 3 AND l.lo_quantity > 69 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 43 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 400019 AND COUNT(*) >= 615 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 24 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 16 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 349254 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 199273 AND d_ship.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring') AND p.p_size > 27 AND p.p_color = 'red' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3535940 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 1 AND COUNT(*) >= 262 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 176;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_custkey) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 34 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19926302 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19943996 AND p.p_size > 36 AND p.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND d.d_holidayfl = 1 AND d.d_weekdayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 85680836 AND COUNT(*) >= 995 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = '1992-01-01') = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 13 AND 36 AND dd.d_year >= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND dd_commit.d_holidayfl = 0 AND s.s_region != c.c_region AND lo.lo_discount > (SELECT AVG(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19926195) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT 0.01 * SUM(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19965471 AND 19965641) AND COUNT(*) > 589 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_quantity > 6) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 86643866 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 2 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 35575781 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue, SUM(l.lo_supplycost * l.lo_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost * l.lo_quantity)) AS gross_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 39 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 16 AND p.p_size <= 42 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 29664 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6268645 AND COUNT(*) > 653 ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND s.s_nation LIKE 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_year >= 1994.14 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5777082.83 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19931088 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1997 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 146191 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 17 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1998 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 581733 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 45.68 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.48 AND 7.59 AND dd.d_year >= 1993.12 AND p.p_size >= 22.3 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4580520.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 39.65 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 1.08 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_quantity) AS median_quantity, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_discount) AS p75_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND l.lo_discount >= 2 AND l.lo_discount <= 8 AND p.p_size >= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 179526 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub_lo.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder sub_lo WHERE sub_lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub_lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19929744 AND 19967795) AS max_order_total_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount >= 5 AND lo.lo_quantity > 52 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 29 AND 32 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1271197 AND COUNT(*) > 142 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 536;
