SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_datekey ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON l.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (l.lo_orderdate + l.lo_shippriority) = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 6 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 34 AND dd_commit.d_holidayfl = 0 AND dd_ship.d_weekdayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_month, dd.d_datekey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7877304 AND COUNT(*) > 866 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_datekey LIMIT 2419;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(inner_l.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19941777 ) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 702127 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 690065 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN lineorder l ON s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND d.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 371767 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 364 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supplycost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS p90_ordertotalprice FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 426546 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 63 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1999 AND p.p_size > 31 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 53837 AND COUNT(*) > 510 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS total_order_value, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue, MAX(lo.lo_quantity) AS max_quantity, MIN(lo.lo_tax) AS min_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 21406.88 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 27.85 AND 75.33 AND d.d_year >= 1994.66 AND p.p_size > 19.97 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') AND lo.lo_discount < 0.35 AND (lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' OR lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 388882.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 72.92 AND AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) < 173.45 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 5520.21;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 918766.49 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 97.08 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993.69 AND 1995.16 AND p.p_size > 38.3 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 94226.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 47.85 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19941163 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19959753 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND (d.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 OR d.d_holidayfl = 1) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 54 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 29 AND 5 AND (p.p_container = 'JUMBO BOX' OR p.p_container = 'JUMBO PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1681472 AND COUNT(*) >= 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1993 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND p.p_size >= 13 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9877510 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 8 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 24 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size >= 28 AND p.p_size <= 35 AND (c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9961918 AND COUNT(*) >= 111 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 2116 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (c.c_region), ()) ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 26 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 145194 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_region AS cust1_region, c2.c_region AS cust2_region, p.p_category AS part_category, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2, AVG(l1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust1, AVG(l2.lo_discount) AS avg_discount_cust2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.lo_orderkey) AS order_count_cust1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.lo_orderkey) AS order_count_cust2, SUM(l1.lo_quantity * l1.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost_cust1, SUM(l2.lo_quantity * l2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost_cust2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder l1 JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_partkey = l2.lo_partkey AND l1.lo_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey AND l1.lo_orderdate <> l2.lo_orderdate JOIN customer c1 ON l1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON l2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l1.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l1.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON l1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON l1.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d3 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d3.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d4 ON l2.lo_commitdate = d4.d_datekey WHERE l1.lo_revenue > 3111394.88 AND l2.lo_revenue > 5625941.18 AND l1.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l2.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1994.65 AND 1996.97 AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1994.47 AND 1996.22 AND p.p_size > 3.71 AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_region, c2.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d1.d_year, d2.d_year HAVING SUM(l1.lo_quantity) > 1618.51 AND SUM(l2.lo_quantity) > 8931.84 ORDER BY total_revenue_cust1 DESC, total_revenue_cust2 DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(lo.lo_tax) AS avg_tax, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1992 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND p.p_size >= 37 AND lo.lo_quantity > 4 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8002465 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 AND COUNT(*) >= 793 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_region_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19949470 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19932619 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND p.p_size > 3 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4914845 AND COUNT(*) >= 596 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7317;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND lo.lo_quantity > 34 AND p.p_size >= 29 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND dd.d_year <= 1997 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9781291 AND COUNT(*) >= 18 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year) AS segment_year_revenue, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 785524.55 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 92.66 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1994.51 AND 1993.99 AND p.p_size > 33.25 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.75 AND 0.53 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 347224.37 AND COUNT(*) > 333.82 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 8 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 521589 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_custkey;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 6 AND d.d_year = 1996 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9012378 AND COUNT(*) >= 546 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 962994 ORDER BY c.c_nation, revenue_rank_in_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, SUM(l1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l2.lo_discount) AS avg_related_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l1 ON c.c_custkey = l1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder l2 ON l1.lo_partkey = l2.lo_partkey AND l1.lo_suppkey = l2.lo_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l1.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND l1.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 15 AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region HAVING SUM(l1.lo_revenue) > 886271 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 45 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 508234 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 634683.17 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 68.14 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.59 AND 1.47 AND d.d_year >= 1998.43 AND p.p_size > 18.27 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 464496.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 15.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 930038 AND l.lo_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 70 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 40 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3653953 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 54 AND dd.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size >= 46 AND c.c_nation IN ('ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA', 'ALGERIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 30954616 AND COUNT(*) > 141 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 270;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = dd_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date dd_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = '1992-01-01') = dd_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 14 AND 44 AND dd.d_year >= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND dd_commit.d_holidayfl = 0 AND s.s_region != c.c_region AND lo.lo_discount > (SELECT AVG(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19948948) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT 0.01 * SUM(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19948963 AND 19960607) AND COUNT(*) > 154 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_quantity > 20) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS running_nation_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.7 AND 7.22 AND d.d_year >= 1994.69 AND p.p_size > 26.94 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 757624.9 AND COUNT(*) >= 921.5 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8959700 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate AND lo_quantity > 19) AS max_extended_price_for_day FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 42 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 746256 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 22 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 20666738 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19951144 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19939532 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND p.p_size > 46 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 52114440 ORDER BY c.c_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_discount) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19944580 AND 19981147) AS max_discount_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount >= 2 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 102991 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 51271908 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 25 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 22135698 AND COUNT(*) >= 3399 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 96102.64 AND d.d_year >= 1995.95 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(l.lo_orderkey) < 10.07 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 692031 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'RAIL') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 50 AND 14 AND dd.d_year >= 1998 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19968710 AND 19939578) AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 85 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, gross_profit DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( l.lo_revenue > 528008.88 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' ) OR ( l.lo_quantity < 43.68 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.74 AND 1.31 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 239877.89 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l3.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND d2.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND l3.lo_quantity > 74.54 ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1088951.96 AND COUNT(*) >= 119.46 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 7032.34;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brands_purchased FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1997 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4434179 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_region, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 2 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 2015 AND p.p_size > 15 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7701414 AND COUNT(*) > 751 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year LIMIT 9404;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 12 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND l.lo_quantity > ( SELECT AVG(lo_quantity) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19932351 AND 19980588 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2868227 AND COUNT(*) >= 36 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 112;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND lo.lo_quantity > 38.99 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.29 AND 4.36 AND d.d_year >= 1997.24 AND p.p_size > 47.6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s2.s_nation = s.s_nation AND lo2.lo_revenue > 77244.8 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo3.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND d2.d_year = d.d_year AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND lo3.lo_ordertotalprice < 6499.42 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 217636.36 AND COUNT(*) >= 68.6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1997 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 9 AND p.p_size >= 32 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 6826612 AND COUNT(*) >= 479 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12month_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 11 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 45 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_month HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 48882 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, d.d_month DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(inner_l.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder inner_l WHERE inner_l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND inner_l.lo_orderdate >= 19964302) AS max_revenue_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 3 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 960776 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 797611 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 17 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 53597527 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.96 AND 6.87 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 406971 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM ( SELECT lo_partkey, MAX(lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY lo_partkey ) sub ) AS max_part_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 996736 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_national_revenue_by_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Winter') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 44 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = lo.lo_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= lo.lo_orderdate - 30 AND lo2.lo_orderdate <= lo.lo_orderdate + 30 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 348437 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 95576 AND COUNT(*) > 23 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4914 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM lineorder l INNER JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 8 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 35209 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 19 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3365061 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 15 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year) ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 24 AND lo.lo_quantity < 28 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 26031162 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 60 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year ASC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND s.s_nation LIKE 'ALGERIA' AND d.d_year >= 1993.11 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 91664740.42 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 2 AND l.lo_quantity > 72 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size IN (8, 8, 39) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4984520 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, d1.d_year AS order_year, d2.d_year AS commit_year, p1.p_category AS part_category, p2.p_brand1 AS part_brand, s1.s_region AS supplier_region, s2.s_nation AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo1.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo1.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo2.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, SUM(lo1.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo1.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_region, d1.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(lo1.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c1.c_custkey, p1.p_category ORDER BY d1.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM lineorder lo1 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_custkey = lo2.lo_custkey AND lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey AND lo1.lo_orderdate < lo2.lo_commitdate JOIN customer c1 ON lo1.lo_custkey = c1.c_custkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN part p1 ON lo1.lo_partkey = p1.p_partkey JOIN part p2 ON lo2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey JOIN supplier s1 ON lo1.lo_suppkey = s1.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s2 ON lo2.lo_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo2.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo1.lo_revenue > 664413.18 AND lo2.lo_supplycost > 1878.49 AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1995 AND c1.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p1.p_size >= 47 AND s1.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, p1.p_category, p2.p_brand1, s1.s_region, s2.s_nation, c1.c_region HAVING SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) > 68623.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) >= 14 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_year, cust1_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 380390 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 542529 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19929653 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 7.54 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.34 AND 4.55 AND d.d_year >= 1992.06 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 97418.26 ORDER BY l2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 81.52 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 224673.34 AND COUNT(*) > 92.68 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_nation ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_category_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND l.lo_quantity > 21 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 3 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 30500 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank_in_segment_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN (SELECT lo_orderpriority FROM lineorder WHERE lo_revenue > 515514 AND lo_quantity >= 63 GROUP BY lo_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(*) > 62) AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1996 AND p.p_size >= 49 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND s.s_region = (SELECT s_region FROM supplier WHERE s_nation = c.c_nation LIMIT 1) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.52 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = d.d_year - 1)) AND COUNT(*) >= 410 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_discount) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19926928 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19930596) AS avg_customer_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 649078 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 26 AND 47 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND p.p_size > 3 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(inner_sub.lo_revenue) * 0.96 FROM lineorder inner_sub JOIN dim_date inner_d ON inner_sub.lo_orderdate = inner_d.d_datekey WHERE inner_d.d_year = d.d_year AND inner_d.d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason) AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 51 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_nation_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 660770 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5872351 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 36 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6697719 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_customer_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 99 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') AND p.p_size > 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5230449 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 9224;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19939813 ) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 146510 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 41 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19958545 AND 19964833) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6029130 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_color, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_color) AS aggregated_colors, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS prev_revenue_in_group FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 639499.73 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 49.67 AND p.p_size <= 5.6 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.9 AND 5.51 AND d1.d_year = 1992.05 AND d2.d_year >= 1996.44 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4183378.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 994.55 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, supplier_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 491.41;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount > 5 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19940223 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19968676 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 97996058 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 38 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 86252024 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19941224 AND 19942252) AS revenue_deviation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 9 AND p.p_size > 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, l.lo_partkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(sub2.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder sub2 WHERE sub2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19970225 AND 19955053) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) AS prev_period_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 850423.48 AND l.lo_quantity >= 61.92 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.09 AND 1.47 AND d.d_year >= 1995.87 AND d.d_year <= 1996.9 AND p.p_size > 17.11 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3617539.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 161.85 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 27 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5932086 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 34 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 656;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 7 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 80767995 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 31 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 72407297 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND l.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_quantity > 11) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6731823 ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND p.p_size > 32 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 86907275 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 125 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_year, c.c_region, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19965287 AND 19973099) AS max_order_total_per_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount >= 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 44 AND 9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 7706822 AND COUNT(*) > 938 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;
