SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 38 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1999 AND p.p_size > 1 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 78427389 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = lo.lo_shipmode) IS NOT NULL WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 37 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum <= 199251 AND p.p_size > 23 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate) < 68712 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 414691 AND COUNT(*) > 4 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3917;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 18 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 267210 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_revenue_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND l.lo_quantity > 35 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size >= 21 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1430846 AND COUNT(*) >= 526 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND dd.d_year = 1994 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 425943 AND COUNT(*) >= 95 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 45 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 748773 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_rev) FROM (SELECT d2.d_year, SUM(l2.lo_revenue) AS max_rev FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey GROUP BY d2.d_year) sub WHERE sub.d_year = d.d_year) AS max_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 35 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1380830 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 43 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2614445 AND COUNT(*) >= 599 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 44 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND p.p_size > 31 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6449780 AND COUNT(*) > 8511 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 9 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (s.s_region, p.p_category), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 53368150 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, MIN(l.lo_discount) AS min_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_region_pair, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year)) AS revenue_year_over_year_change FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 47 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 36 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 47238932 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 810 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 32 AND p.p_size <= 1 AND lo.lo_discount >= 3 AND lo.lo_discount <= 10 AND dd.d_year >= 1994 AND dd.d_year <= 1993 AND lo.lo_commitdate >= 19964990 AND lo.lo_commitdate <= 19963359 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 60280405 AND COUNT(*) >= 230 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 7 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 33 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 6990346 AND COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d1 ON lo.lo_orderdate = d1.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d2 ON lo.lo_commitdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND d1.d_year >= 1992 AND d2.d_year <= 1992 AND lo.lo_partkey IN (SELECT p2.p_partkey FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 46 AND p2.p_brand1 IN ('MFGR#11', 'MFGR#11')) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 34621607 AND COUNT(*) >= 824 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( (lo.lo_quantity > 7 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7) OR (lo.lo_extendedprice > 23855 AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'AIR')) ) AND NOT (p.p_size < 7 AND p.p_color = 'RED') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_year >= 1995 AND dd.d_year <= 1997 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES') AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 101495 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 80 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 5 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 45 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5101424 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 41 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 8 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 19 AND dd.d_year >= 1991 AND p.p_size >= 14 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8041692 AND COUNT(*) > 703 ORDER BY dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_region, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.d_year, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year, p.p_category) AS cumulative_revenue_by_year_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 10 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 44 AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5156213 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 1792 ORDER BY c.c_nation, revenue_rank_in_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_color LIKE 'blue' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_year >= 1994.08 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.28 AND 9.8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 465402.91 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 69678 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1998 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate <> lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue ORDER BY lo2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 94 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 54888 AND COUNT(*) > 98 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_quantity) DESC) AS quantity_rank_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON l.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 9573239.82 AND l.lo_quantity >= 80.59 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.46 AND 18.32 AND dd.d_year >= 1997.39 AND p.p_size > 8.38 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3502087.86 AND COUNT(*) >= 193.72 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_quantity) > 6710 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category) AS avg_category_revenue_by_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size IN (SELECT p2.p_size FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 24 AND p2.p_color = 'almond' GROUP BY p2.p_size HAVING COUNT(*) > 68) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.15 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19934625 AND 19925504) ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 411103 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 364708 AND l.lo_quantity >= 9 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND p.p_size > 40 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 96498 AND COUNT(*) > 24 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_category_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 28 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 31 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9787354 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 6 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 11 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 202615 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust1_key, c2.c_custkey AS cust2_key, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_orderkey = lo2.lo_orderkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey AND dd.d_year >= 1993.52 AND lo1.lo_revenue > 29439.81 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 4.49 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, total_revenue_cust1 DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 41.12 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 20064.81 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996.91 AND 1995.83 ) OR ( l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.82 AND 4.31 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#12' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= l.lo_orderdate - 30 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= l.lo_orderdate + 30 AND l2.lo_revenue > 43395.34 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l3.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND d2.d_holidayfl = 1 AND d2.d_year = d.d_year ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 597146.84 AND COUNT(*) > 41.18 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 270.35;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 220934 AND l.lo_quantity BETWEEN 6 AND 18 AND l.lo_discount >= 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 44 AND (c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' OR s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA') AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 438049 AND COUNT(*) >= 25 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 15 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3241;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 725837 AND l.lo_quantity BETWEEN 9 AND 64 AND l.lo_discount >= 5 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size > 6 AND (c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES' OR s.s_nation = 'UNITED KINGDOM') AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Summer') AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH', '3-MEDIUM') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 222681 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1891222 AND COUNT(*) > 53 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 7529;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 29 AND p.p_size <= 16 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 20 AND lo.lo_revenue > 832508 AND c.c_custkey IN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey FROM lineorder lo_inner JOIN dim_date d_inner ON lo_inner.lo_orderdate = d_inner.d_datekey WHERE d_inner.d_sellingseason = 'Winter' AND lo_inner.lo_revenue > 275274 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey HAVING SUM(lo_inner.lo_quantity) > 6983 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 586883 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 344 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_discount) AS p75_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND l.lo_quantity > 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 827629 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = lo.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_for_combo FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 2 AND lo.lo_quantity > 56 AND dd.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 30 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, lo.lo_orderdate, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4861720 AND COUNT(*) > 792 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_profit DESC LIMIT 817;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND p.p_size >= 8 AND p.p_size <= 44 AND lo.lo_discount >= 5 AND lo.lo_discount <= 4 AND lo.lo_quantity > 17 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 35388 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 112718 AND COUNT(*) > 93 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 12 AND d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_size > 21 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 855469 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.lo_extendedprice) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_extended_price_per_combo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 973576 AND l.lo_quantity >= 7 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 2006 AND p.p_size > 12 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7437135 AND COUNT(*) >= 143 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 627531.13 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 38.8 AND p.p_size <= 40.46 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.18 AND 1.75 AND d.d_year >= 1992.08 AND d.d_year <= 1995.2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2742787.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 56.38 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 6301.28;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_nation_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 47 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 61135 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 31 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND (d.d_holidayfl = 1 OR d.d_weekdayfl = 1) AND lo.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate + 30 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 593474 AND COUNT(*) > 473 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_revenue, SUM(l.lo_supplycost * l.lo_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost * l.lo_quantity)) AS gross_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 10 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND p.p_size >= 2 AND p.p_size <= 72 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 11673 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 7891642 AND COUNT(*) > 291 ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, s.s_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 717825.97 AND l.lo_quantity >= 26.28 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.76 AND 2.87 AND d.d_year >= 2005.03 AND p.p_size > 3.61 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4080440.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 760.67 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND lo.lo_discount <= 4 AND p.p_size > 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1056929 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1990 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5831900 ORDER BY c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS region_year_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 39 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 1996 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, order_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, order_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category), (c.c_region), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 936984 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, order_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brand_list FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.37 AND d.d_year >= 1998.0 AND p.p_size > 42.03 GROUP BY c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2707698.95 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 622920.19 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19960287 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND l.lo_discount <= 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 373665 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 16 AND l.lo_supplycost < 604 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 30 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1996 ) AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 493003 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19969356 AND 19936502) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason, p.p_category ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS region_category_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19973995 AND p.p_size > 22 AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1995, 1994) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4677409 AND AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 44 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue_nation_category_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 15 AND l.lo_quantity > 54 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 65104086 AND COUNT(*) >= 545 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN ( SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year >= 1997 AND d2.d_year <= 1996 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' ) AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 68 AND p.p_size >= 25 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4700243 AND COUNT(*) >= 206 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 4276;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1995 AND p.p_size >= 13 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate <> lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 665481 ORDER BY lo2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 21 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3465610 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 258;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 13 AND l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 4 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 75356772 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( lo.lo_revenue > 4119406.76 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1998) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 9 ) OR ( lo.lo_quantity < 2 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1993) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_revenue > 36496.38 AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo3.lo_orderdate > lo.lo_orderdate AND lo3.lo_revenue < 144.82) ) AND p.p_size >= 3 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND dd.d_sellingseason != 'Winter' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 312523.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 26 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 15 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 400;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 11 AND d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19967254) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 41 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 18944 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN part p2 ON l2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND p2.p_brand1 = p.p_brand1 AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 4798 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN supplier s3 ON l3.lo_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s3.s_nation <> s.s_nation AND l3.lo_orderdate BETWEEN l.lo_orderdate - 30 AND l.lo_orderdate + 30 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 337498 AND COUNT(*) > 81 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 4986;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19948051 AND l2.lo_orderdate <= 19931648) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 788195 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND d.d_monthnuminyear = 7 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9440735 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lo_discount > 9 THEN l.lo_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 16 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3999749 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) DESC) AS supplycost_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 9 AND lo.lo_quantity > 32 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND dd.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size > 36 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 67620839 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS segment_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 49 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 14974 AND dd.d_year >= 1996 AND dd.d_year <= 1993 AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND (dd.d_lastdayinweekfl = 1 OR dd.d_holidayfl = 1) AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND p.p_size > 21 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 207353 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 617 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_by_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.lo_quantity > 1 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND p.p_size > 23 AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 10047145 AND COUNT(*) > 619 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 48.4 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.3 AND 2.16 AND d.d_year >= 1992.5 AND p.p_size >= 25.5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 944078.52 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_quantity), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_quantity FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 5932829.13 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND lo.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' AND p.p_size >= 17.54 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992.81 AND 1993.9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 4745325.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 23.39 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 584.24;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_region_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.lo_quantity > 11.26 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.05 AND 9.97 AND d.d_year >= 1997.47 AND p.p_size > 27.95 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN part p2 ON l2.lo_partkey = p2.p_partkey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19967003.13 AND 19963663.68 AND p2.p_color = 'RED' AND l2.lo_revenue > l.lo_revenue * 0.5 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN supplier s3 ON l3.lo_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND s3.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND l3.lo_orderdate < 19968046.28 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 25831042.1 AND COUNT(*) > 507.62 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 8937 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 3896 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1938620 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_extendedprice * (1 - l.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19973541 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19956629 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND p.p_size > 2 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1994 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 83279008 ORDER BY c.c_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 9 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1997 AND p.p_size >= 11 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, c.c_nation), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 50 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 89 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1993 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 1 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 76681284 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment LIKE 'BUILDING' AND p.p_brand1 LIKE 'MFGR#1' AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.92 AND 8.91 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1 HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 100611.11 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE ( lo.lo_revenue > 831965.46 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1993) AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 9 ) OR ( lo.lo_quantity < 42 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1992) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_revenue > 25913.5 AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo3 WHERE lo3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo3.lo_orderdate > lo.lo_orderdate AND lo3.lo_revenue < 999.6) ) AND p.p_size >= 25 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND dd.d_sellingseason != 'Winter' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 79729.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 31 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 7 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 930;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost * lo.lo_quantity) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND lo.lo_quantity > 30.84 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.52 AND 1.23 AND dd.d_year >= 1996.95 AND p.p_size > 26.01 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5809063.09 AND COUNT(*) >= 432.01 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1994 AND l.lo_discount >= 10 AND l.lo_discount <= 2 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 753349 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.15 AND 12.27 AND l.lo_quantity > 28.48 AND d.d_year >= 1996.6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l2.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND d2.d_sellingseason = d.d_sellingseason AND l2.lo_revenue > 306210.32 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 WHERE l3.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l3.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l3.lo_orderpriority = '5-LOW' AND l3.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4406257.92 AND COUNT(*) > 21.19 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_quantity > 46.44 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.61 AND 2.77 AND d.d_year >= 1992.3 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 199083.32 AND p.p_size > 31.83 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 269349.34 AND COUNT(*) >= 20.44 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3089.94;
