SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.87 AND 5.85 AND d.d_year = 1997.91 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, s.s_nation HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 979215.32 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3496478 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND dd.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 34 AND s.s_nation IN ('UNITED STATES', 'FRANCE', 'JAPAN') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, dd.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1638347 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year) AS segment_year_revenue, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 577750.87 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 23.19 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1993.86 AND 1996.96 AND p.p_size > 23.18 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.57 AND 0.9 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 26880.44 AND COUNT(*) > 274.05 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1995 AND p.p_size > 7 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 7 AND c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 4486681 AND COUNT(*) >= 682 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 3971;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 195168.04 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 19.84 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2.33 AND 5.39 AND dd.d_year >= 1997.81 AND p.p_size >= 24.05 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 331399.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 95.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_custkey LIMIT 7259.37;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1995 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5080300 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 932443.32 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 85.22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6.58 AND 11.27 AND d.d_year >= 1991.36 AND p.p_size > 15.02 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 347797.8 AND COUNT(*) > 81.56 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 869052 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 13 AND 96 AND lo.lo_discount >= 0 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND (p.p_size > 35 OR p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK')) AND s.s_region NOT IN ('AFRICA', 'ASIA') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH', '3-MEDIUM') AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND lo.lo_commitdate < lo.lo_orderdate + 26 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate BETWEEN d.d_datekey - 94 AND d.d_datekey - 1 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 410995 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3990768 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 26 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 2 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 6268;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_discount > 1.19) AS high_discount_orders FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1993.94 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 779.87 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 24 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size >= 32 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 279176 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS p75_extendedprice, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p90_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 344048.27 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 4.01 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 5.19 AND 9.85 AND d.d_year >= 1995.89 AND p.p_size > 14.19 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 279315.0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 13.51 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(lo2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder lo2 ON p2.p_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extendedprice FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 20 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5310276 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_size > 22 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 335340 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_season_cumulative, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 5 AND 4 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND lo.lo_quantity > 1 AND lo.lo_revenue > 353837 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 338471 AND COUNT(*) > 72 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 971;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, dd.d_year ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS nation_year_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, dd.d_sellingseason ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size >= 15 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 237643 AND COUNT(*) >= 656 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 4378 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19976916 AND sub.lo_orderdate <= 19974221) AS avg_cust_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 397836 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1993 AND p.p_size > 40 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 1 AND c.c_nation = 'ALGERIA' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1572236 AND COUNT(*) >= 168 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 8592;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(l2.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19960396) AS max_order_total_for_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19975848 AND 19959998 AND l.lo_discount >= 9 AND p.p_size >= 10 AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND d.d_year >= 1993 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 96973436 AND COUNT(*) >= 119 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category LIMIT 8638;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue - l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 40 AND p.p_size <= 9 AND l.lo_discount >= 1 AND l.lo_discount <= 8 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE', 'AUTOMOBILE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, s.s_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9495188 AND COUNT(*) >= 59 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 2538;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19978757 ) AS avg_quantity_per_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 689273 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS brands_purchased FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND d.d_year = 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9843459 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 2 AND lo.lo_quantity < 54 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 541094 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_region LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount/100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear) AS prev_month_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 21.06 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7.15 AND 5.67 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 48393.41 AND d.d_year >= 1994.84 AND d.d_year <= 1997.26 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 39.1 AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'ASIA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_month, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 109634.9 AND COUNT(*) > 730.7 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM customer c INNER JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey INNER JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey, AVG(lo_inner.lo_quantity) AS avg_qty_per_part FROM lineorder lo_inner WHERE lo_inner.lo_orderdate >= 19921511 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey ) AS sub ON c.c_custkey = sub.lo_custkey AND p.p_partkey = sub.lo_partkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19980675 AND 19977273 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 0 AND p.p_size > 46 AND (s.s_region = 'AMERICA' OR c.c_nation = 'UNITED STATES') AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND (sub.avg_qty_per_part IS NULL OR lo.lo_quantity > sub.avg_qty_per_part * 1.86) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5196662 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 87 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 2079;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(lo2.lo_ordertotalprice) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19951410 AND lo2.lo_orderdate <= 19967028) AS max_order_total_for_customer, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19962904 AND 19928623 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND p.p_size >= 15 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9448050 AND COUNT(*) >= 825 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 3352;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS cumulative_revenue_by_region_year_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND l.lo_quantity > 86 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1993 AND 1995 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND p.p_size > 21 AND l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation), GROUPING SETS((p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason)) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 62202618 AND COUNT(*) >= 694 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year LIMIT 3771;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category) AS avg_category_revenue_by_region FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size IN (SELECT p2.p_size FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 34 AND p2.p_color = 'almond' GROUP BY p2.p_size HAVING COUNT(*) > 30) GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.68 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19923437 AND 19947429) ORDER BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 1184248 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 47 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 751632 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 10.95 AND lo.lo_extendedprice > 38705.78 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 8.49 AND 2.22 AND dd.d_year >= 1993.1 AND dd.d_year <= 1996.29 AND p.p_size > 20.73 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate < lo.lo_orderdate AND lo2.lo_revenue > 40413.15 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 750454.79 AND COUNT(*) > 89.89 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND d.d_year = 1994 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' ORDER BY l2.lo_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 33 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 863041 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 2 AND 29 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1993 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 48 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 199636 AND d_ship.d_holidayfl = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5828134 AND COUNT(*) >= 883 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 12 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, d.d_year LIMIT 6514;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_extendedprice) AS median_extended_price, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_supplycost) AS p75_supply_cost, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS p90_order_total_price FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 515862 AND lo.lo_quantity BETWEEN 44 AND 91 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND p.p_size > 10 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 130943 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 26 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_supplycost) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_partkey = l.lo_partkey AND sub.lo_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND sub.lo_orderdate BETWEEN 19932134 AND 19939602) AS avg_supplycost_for_part_supplier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19960323 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19932553 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND p.p_size > 48 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, l.lo_partkey, l.lo_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 426369 AND COUNT(*) >= 693 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS nation_year_season_cumulative_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS category_revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year >= 1998 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring') AND l.lo_orderdate <= (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year <= 1997 AND d_sellingseason = 'Spring') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 1 AND p.p_size > 17 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19922473 AND l2.lo_revenue > 65719 GROUP BY l2.lo_custkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.lo_partkey) > 79 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 259680 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation LIMIT 394;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, (SELECT MAX(lo_discount) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate = l.lo_orderdate) AS max_discount_for_date FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 688043.54 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 6 AND 11 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), l.lo_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 310.33 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9341698 ORDER BY d.d_year, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT AVG(lo2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19961899) AS avg_customer_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 339433 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1994.07 AND p.p_brand1 LIKE '%Brand%' AND s.s_nation LIKE '%Nation%' GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 857490.85 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 16 AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 59060797 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) >= 766 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, p.p_category, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum) AS cumulative_revenue_by_cust_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_category FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 1 AND lo.lo_quantity > 64 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 33 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 3629561 AND COUNT(*) > 815 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, s.s_region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year) AS segment_year_total_revenue, (SUM(lo.lo_revenue) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year), 0)) * 100 AS revenue_percentage_of_segment_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_shipmode LIKE '%' AND p.p_type LIKE '%' AND p.p_color LIKE '%' AND s.s_region LIKE '%' AND c.c_mktsegment LIKE '%' AND dd.d_sellingseason LIKE '%' AND lo.lo_quantity > 5.22 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0.13 AND 1.89 AND dd.d_year BETWEEN 1998.13 AND 1997.34 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 32841851.68 AND COUNT(*) >= 533.86 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year LIMIT 79115.9;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(lo.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year) AS cumulative_nation_year_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND lo.lo_quantity > 37 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 37 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 93109007 AND COUNT(*) >= 885 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19923024 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19939527 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND d.d_year <= 1997 AND d.d_sellingseason IN ('Spring', 'Spring') AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND p.p_size > 10 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (7, 12, 4) OR d.d_holidayfl = 1) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 87057 AND COUNT(*) >= 25 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_price) FROM (SELECT p2.p_category, MAX(l2.lo_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM part p2 JOIN lineorder l2 ON p2.p_partkey = l2.lo_partkey GROUP BY p2.p_category) sub WHERE sub.p_category = p.p_category) AS category_max_extended_price FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND p.p_size > 45 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3320845 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2612171 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1993 AND p.p_size > 36 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3157814 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1996 AND p.p_size >= 39 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND l.lo_quantity > 18 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND s.s_region = 'AFRICA' AND p.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG', 'WRAP BOX', 'WRAP PKG') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 8324448 AND COUNT(*) >= 35 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE dd.d_year >= 1993 AND dd.d_year <= 1998 AND dd.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 5 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 107530 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(l.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE ( l.lo_revenue > 238622.74 AND l.lo_orderdate >= '19920101' AND l.lo_orderdate <= '19920101' ) OR ( l.lo_quantity < 38.46 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1.03 AND 2.56 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate < l.lo_orderdate AND l2.lo_revenue > 110864.78 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l3 JOIN dim_date d2 ON l3.lo_orderdate = d2.d_datekey WHERE l3.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND d2.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND l3.lo_quantity > 78.28 ) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3117376.05 AND COUNT(*) >= 288.21 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 6031.4;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, s.s_region AS supplier_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_region_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN ( SELECT lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey, MAX(lo_inner.lo_orderdate) AS latest_order_date FROM lineorder lo_inner WHERE lo_inner.lo_quantity > 44 GROUP BY lo_inner.lo_custkey, lo_inner.lo_partkey ) recent_orders ON lo.lo_custkey = recent_orders.lo_custkey AND lo.lo_partkey = recent_orders.lo_partkey WHERE lo.lo_orderdate >= 19926434 AND lo.lo_orderdate <= 19925015 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 34 AND 16 AND lo.lo_discount >= 0 AND c.c_region IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE') AND d.d_year >= 1998 AND s.s_region = 'ASIA' AND lo.lo_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(lo_sub.lo_revenue) * 1.5 FROM lineorder lo_sub JOIN dim_date d_sub ON lo_sub.lo_orderdate = d_sub.d_datekey WHERE d_sub.d_year = d.d_year - 1 AND lo_sub.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, p.p_brand1, p.p_category, s.s_nation, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 8477537 AND COUNT(*) > 507 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, SUM(lo.lo_extendedprice * (1 - lo.lo_discount / 100.0)) AS net_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 230342.1 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 85.25 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4.19 AND 6.7 AND d.d_year >= 1994.38 AND p.p_size > 8.76 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' AND d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 288522.36 AND COUNT(*) > 8.97 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19932690) AS recent_order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1997 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 601323 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1992 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) * 0.77 FROM lineorder WHERE lo_orderdate >= 19974243 AND lo_orderdate <= 19957459) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_nation_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') AND l.lo_quantity > 34 AND l.lo_extendedprice > 34888 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1997 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND l2.lo_revenue > 35354 ORDER BY l2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 61 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 625002 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_quantity) DESC) AS quantity_rank_region_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19942055 AND p.p_size > 17 AND d.d_year IN (1993, 1995, 1994) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 30668890 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 9 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 13 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 944131 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_nation, revenue_rank_nation_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lo.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 7 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_quantity) > 77476 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 11 AND l.lo_quantity > 17 AND d.d_year >= 1995 AND p.p_size > 15 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 311590 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1998 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 451264 UNION SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_sellingseason = 'Spring' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING AVG(l.lo_quantity) < 33 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 89181.4 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19957518 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE d.d_year = 1995 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = l.lo_suppkey AND s.s_nation = 'UNITED STATES' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 729431 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1994 AND l.lo_discount <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 2284509 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 67 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 14 AND d.d_year >= 2018 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 201271 AND s.s_region = (SELECT s_region FROM supplier WHERE s_nation = c.c_nation LIMIT 1) AND lo.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_partkey = p.p_partkey) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 1991637 AND COUNT(*) > 278 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 4265;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 28 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND d.d_year >= 1994 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category), (c.c_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region), () ) ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS LAST, c.c_nation NULLS LAST, p.p_category NULLS LAST, p.p_brand1 NULLS LAST, d.d_year NULLS LAST, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 5 AND lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size > 46 AND s.s_nation = 'ALGERIA' GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 61396969 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 18 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(sub.lo_revenue) FROM lineorder sub WHERE sub.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND sub.lo_orderdate >= 19921672) AS avg_customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 12 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 289715 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_category, LAG(SUM(l.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_brand1 ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_brand FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 641340.61 AND l.lo_quantity >= 94.5 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.92 AND 1.03 AND d.d_year >= 1997.7 AND p.p_size > 49.86 AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 14639.19 AND COUNT(*) >= 36.84 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, p.p_category;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, (SELECT AVG(l2.lo_quantity) FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderdate >= 19946515) AS avg_quantity_for_customer FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 527483 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.lo_orderdate >= 19930443 AND l.lo_orderdate <= 19978814 AND p.p_size > 47 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = 'URGENT' ORDER BY l2.lo_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 143832 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_sellingseason) AS running_revenue_by_region_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category_region FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19935738 AND p.p_size > 23 AND d.d_year IN (1993, 1995, 1992) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region), (c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 76577037 AND COUNT(*) >= 199 ORDER BY c.c_region, c.c_nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(lo.lo_ordertotalprice) AS max_order_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP', 'RAIL') AND lo.lo_quantity > 33 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 1 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey AND lo2.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND lo2.lo_revenue > lo.lo_revenue * 0.5 ORDER BY lo2.lo_revenue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 177 ) AND p.p_size > 13 AND s.s_region != 'ASIA' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 9932651 AND COUNT(*) > 930 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, s.s_nation LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND d.d_year = 1998 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 974910 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c1.c_custkey AS cust_key1, c2.c_custkey AS cust_key2, c1.c_nation AS cust1_nation, c2.c_nation AS cust2_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) AS shared_order_count, SUM(lo1.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust1, SUM(lo2.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue_cust2 FROM customer c1 JOIN lineorder lo1 ON c1.c_custkey = lo1.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date dd1 ON lo1.lo_orderdate = dd1.d_datekey JOIN lineorder lo2 ON lo1.lo_partkey = lo2.lo_partkey JOIN customer c2 ON lo2.lo_custkey = c2.c_custkey JOIN dim_date dd2 ON lo2.lo_orderdate = dd2.d_datekey WHERE c1.c_custkey < c2.c_custkey AND dd1.d_year = 1993 AND dd2.d_year = 1995 AND lo1.lo_quantity > 26 AND lo2.lo_quantity > 49 GROUP BY c1.c_custkey, c2.c_custkey, c1.c_nation, c2.c_nation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo1.lo_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY shared_order_count DESC, total_revenue_cust1 DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 3 AND l.lo_orderdate >= 19932804 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND lo.lo_quantity > 21 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= (SELECT MIN(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1996) AND lo.lo_orderdate <= (SELECT MAX(d_datekey) FROM dim_date WHERE d_year = 1998) AND p.p_size > 26 AND p.p_container IN ('JUMBO BOX', 'JUMBO PKG') AND s.s_region = 'AMERICA' AND dd.d_holidayfl = 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 263526 AND COUNT(*) > 815 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, dd.d_year, c.c_mktsegment LIMIT 5996;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, SUM(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_category, d.d_sellingseason ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_monthnuminyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_category_season FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 37 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 1 AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 13 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_monthnuminyear HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 9921511 AND AVG(l.lo_discount) < 3 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;
