SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1996 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 521033 EXCEPT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year = 1993 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 844699 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 11 AND d.d_year = 1998 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 459770 INTERSECT SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND l.lo_quantity > 18 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 115171 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c2 ON c.c_nation = c2.c_nation AND c.c_custkey != c2.c_custkey WHERE d.d_year >= 1997 AND d.d_year <= 1998 AND p.p_size > 27 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, c.c_region HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 5362334 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE (lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 4 OR lo.lo_discount = 7) AND lo.lo_quantity > 34 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING') AND NOT (s.s_region = 'AFRICA') AND d.d_year >= 1997 AND p.p_size >= 33 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 840997 AND COUNT(*) >= 13 ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(l.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, (SUM(l.lo_revenue) - SUM(l.lo_supplycost)) AS gross_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_region_year FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_revenue > 256644.4 AND l.lo_quantity >= 27.36 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9.62 AND 3.71 AND d.d_year >= 2011.02 AND p.p_size > 26.24 AND c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (p.p_category, p.p_brand1), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 3318977.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) >= 210.83 ORDER BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_yearmonthnum ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_revenue_nation_category_year FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND l.lo_shipmode = 'AIR' AND p.p_size >= 7 AND l.lo_quantity > 53 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1996 AND d.d_year <= 1992 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, d.d_yearmonthnum HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 63125946 AND COUNT(*) >= 417 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.d_year, c.c_nation;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_brand1, ', ' ORDER BY p.p_brand1) AS aggregated_brands FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 3.27 AND 13.5 AND d.d_year = 1993.76 AND p.p_size > 10.14 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, p.p_category, s.s_region HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 409545.16 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_partkey) AS distinct_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(lo.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder lo JOIN customer c ON lo.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND lo.lo_orderdate >= 19959409 AND p.p_size > 48 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1995 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 86727691 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 6232 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 9 AND 2 AND d.d_year >= 1992 AND p.p_size > 5 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 5182363 ORDER BY c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND d.d_year >= 1994 AND p.p_size > 37 GROUP BY c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 448550 ORDER BY d.d_year, c.c_region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(lo.lo_revenue - lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment, dd.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_segment_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY dd.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date dd ON lo.lo_orderdate = dd.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_revenue > 505174 AND lo.lo_quantity >= 94 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND p.p_size > 41 AND dd.d_year >= 1993 AND dd.d_year <= 1992 AND (c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' OR c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AND s.s_region IN ('AMERICA', 'AMERICA', 'AMERICA') AND lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND dd.d_sellingseason IN ('Winter', 'Winter') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder lo2 WHERE lo2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo2.lo_orderdate >= 19933720 AND lo2.lo_orderdate <= 19980686 AND lo2.lo_revenue > 50946 GROUP BY lo2.lo_custkey HAVING COUNT(*) > 65 ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, s.s_nation, s.s_region, dd.d_year, dd.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 20788 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lo.lo_orderkey) >= 38 AND AVG(lo.lo_discount) < 4 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_custkey, dd.d_year;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderdate IN (SELECT d2.d_datekey FROM dim_date d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1993 AND d2.d_sellingseason = 'Spring') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 300007 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(l.lo_quantity), 0) AS revenue_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(l.lo_revenue) DESC) AS region_revenue_rank FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '1-URGENT', '1-URGENT') AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND l.lo_quantity > 74 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1994 AND p.p_size >= 25 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (c.c_region, c.c_nation, s.s_region, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, p.p_category, d.d_year), (c.c_region, s.s_region, d.d_year), (c.c_region, d.d_year), (s.s_region, d.d_year), (d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason), (d.d_year), () ) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 88469499 AND COUNT(*) >= 440 ORDER BY c.c_region NULLS FIRST, s.s_region NULLS FIRST, d.d_year DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation AS supplier_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(lo.lo_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(lo.lo_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(lo.lo_revenue) - SUM(lo.lo_supplycost) AS total_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(lo.lo_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank_nation_year, LAG(SUM(lo.lo_revenue), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS prev_year_revenue_same_category FROM customer c JOIN lineorder lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON lo.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON lo.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON lo.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_commit ON lo.lo_commitdate = d_commit.d_datekey JOIN dim_date d_ship ON (SELECT d_datekey FROM dim_date WHERE d_date = CAST(lo.lo_orderdate AS character varying)) = d_ship.d_datekey WHERE lo.lo_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND lo.lo_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 34 AND 58 AND lo.lo_discount BETWEEN 2 AND 16 AND d.d_year >= 2004 AND d_commit.d_yearmonthnum >= 201516 AND s.s_region = (SELECT s_region FROM supplier WHERE s_nation = c.c_nation LIMIT 1) AND lo.lo_revenue > (SELECT AVG(lo_revenue) FROM lineorder WHERE lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND lo_partkey = p.p_partkey) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, s.s_name, s.s_nation, p.p_category, p.p_brand1, d.d_year, d.d_sellingseason HAVING SUM(lo.lo_revenue) > 2188551 AND COUNT(*) > 977 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_nation, d.d_year LIMIT 6224;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE d.d_year >= 1992 AND d.d_year <= 1995 AND l.lo_discount BETWEEN 4 AND 3 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 561712 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(SUM(l.lo_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nation, p.p_category ORDER BY d.d_year) AS moving_avg_revenue FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND d.d_year >= 1996 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_quantity) > 5469 ORDER BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year;

SELECT c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_revenue) AS median_revenue, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.lo_discount) AS pct_75_discount FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_quantity > 28 AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1994 AND p.p_size > 14 GROUP BY c.c_nation, p.p_category, d.d_year HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 51607 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN lineorder l ON c.c_custkey = l.lo_custkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE d.d_year = 1992 AND p.p_category = 'MFGR#11' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineorder l2 WHERE l2.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey AND l2.lo_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nation HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 76971 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year, SUM(l.lo_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.lo_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineorder l JOIN customer c ON l.lo_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN part p ON l.lo_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.lo_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN dim_date d ON l.lo_orderdate = d.d_datekey WHERE l.lo_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND d.d_year >= 1995 GROUP BY CUBE(c.c_region, p.p_category, s.s_region, d.d_year) HAVING SUM(l.lo_revenue) > 380216 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
